name: Qingqiu Shen
about: Shen Qingqiu is the protagonist of The Scum Villain's Self-Saving System. He is the Qing Jing Peak Lord and a cultivation master.  Original Shen Qingqiu Shen Jiu, the original, had a sharp and calculating mind and was not above using devious tricks. Even as a slave child, he fought using such underhanded means as poking his opponent's eyes.  He was often cold to others and carried himself in an aloof and elegant manner, as if he was hard to ruffle. This gave him the sense of being an unreachable immortal as described by Luo Binghe. He was also described by Luo as someone bitingly sarcastic.  Post Transmigration Shen Yuan, who transmigrated into the body of Shen Jiu, is a sarcastic, somewhat nerdy millennial. He's a little spoiled, being the child of a rich family in his first life, and more than a little dense.  He has a colorful internal dialogue, arguing with the SYSTEM and complaining about his circumstances. Around Shang Qinghua, this part of his personality is especially obvious, as he yells at the author for the ridiculous plot points he wrote that the both of them now have to deal with.  (Source: The Scum Villain's Self-Saving System Wiki)

Luo Binghe is described as being a tall and extraordinarily handsome youth, with a pair of bright shiny eyes, a bright, sincere smile and a humble look about him. He often wore white clothing, this and his innocent personality leading to Shen Yuan often comparing him to a sheep. However, after his blackening, he frequently favors darker clothing and a less inviting demeanor.   (Source: The Scum Villain's Self-Saving System Wiki)

about: One of Sonic's subordinates (the other being Despair-kun) on the "Bungee Execution Stand", he is an anthropomorphic pink rabbit with the word "SPEER" written on his belly. Although he has a tired expression, he uses powerful karate moves when his eyes are fully open, even in the midst of a bungee jump. He at first causes trouble for Bo-bobo's group, but Bo-bobo scares him with a lion coming out of his afro. Super Rabbit, alongside his two comrades, are defeated when Tokoro Tennosuke seals the trio away in a bottle.  Both Super Rabbit and Despair-kun are later seen worshiping Softon as he uses his power to keep Cyber City from sinking. They also show up to assist Bo-bobo against the Hair Hunters from 100 years ago, but they are rejected by Tennosuke.  During the Neo Maruhage Playoffs, Super Rabbit assists Bo-bobo's group against Halekulani, Haoh, Giga, Shibito, and Lambada.  (Source: Bobobo Wikia)

nicknames: Zetsubou-kun, Emo-boy, The Unknown Sad Sack
about: Despair-kun is a skinny, but well built man wearing a red speedo and two light-blue socks. He is always wearing a brown paper sack over his head. Though the sack has two large eye holes in it, nothing on his face can be seen. His entire head is never seen throughout the entire series, with the exception of his eyes (they can only be seen when he is angry, and they are glowing red when he is like this).  Like his name would suggest, Despair-kun is almost always depressive. During his introduction, he actually tried to commit suicide several times, but with no success. He also gets very angry and aggressive at times, with almost no warning at all. Like many of the other characters, he can also be a little random, as he attempts to join in the rebels hajikelist attacks.  Unlike most of the characters in Bo-bobo, Despair-kun has no real powers. He is not a shinken user, but the random side of his nature would suggest that he is a hajikelist (but he only uses these abilities to enhance the other rebels nonsensical actions). Normally, he only fights by exchanging physical blows.  (Source: Bobobo Wikia)

name: Nekota
about: Nekota may come off indifferent and distant, but that's because he's not good at talking about himself. He's not cold or mean, but he isn't outgoing and loud. He's just laid-back and calm, able to get along with his classmates just fine. He also tends to be late to class.  He's a really good person that cares about people and he's quite observant since he can tell when Mikki is having a rough time or going through difficult or confusing situations.  He's not aware that Mikki sees him with a cat's face. He also has a younger sister named "Meguru" and he cooks for her, himself, and his father, who works late and can't watch the two. He takes on the mother role because he doesn't have a mother.  He appears to enjoy hanging out with Mikki and his other friends. At the beginning, he gets weirded out by Mikki because she'd stare and follow him and being really stalker-ish. And that's because she wanted to see his "human" face. But even so, he still cares about her despite being a bit weirded out. Even though she weirds him out, he likes that part of her.  They become close throughout the series. It's quite obvious that he likes Mikki, romantically.

about: Acnologia, also known as The Black Dragon of the Apocalypse, is an extremely powerful dragon that flies around the continent or world. It once faced Fairy Tail's strongest Mage, Gildarts, in battle, and was said to have instantly defeated him, tearing out several organs in the process. Acnologia's power is such that even the most evil and powerful Mage in the world, Zeref, fears him.  Acnologia seems to have a deep connection with the Black Mage Zeref, as Zeref seems to know it very well, and was able to sense its arrival quite a while before it actually arrived. It is said by Zeref that Acnologia "Heralds the End of Eras," although what this means is still unclear.    (Source: Fairy Tail Wikia)

about: Tou Sengyoku is a doushi of Kingou Island and the daughter of an officer of the Yin army Tou Kyuukou. Under Bunchuu's orders she spied on the Zhou army, but eventually switched side to Taikoubou and the Kongrong mountains after falling in love with Dokouson. She is afraid of birds and all disgusting things. Her fear of birds came from Ryuukan stalking her, because he is an archer that can control a large phoenix.  Her paopei is a magic ball Gokouseki that chases her target and makes it's face 'strangely lewd' (similar to 70s shoujo manga) when it makes contact. When Taiitsu Shinjin examined her paopei he discovered a 20% limiter inserted in it. Removing the limiter increased the impact power of the ball and allowed it to fire splitting images that distract enemy, but increased the energy drain from Sengyoku.

Elizabeth though easily defeats her without even utilizing her Volt Weapon. She was the first E-Pandora to try the Mark III medicine, which was a failure and almost killed her. It is revealed that she has a younger brother who is in a wheelchair.  Her Volt Weapon is an unnamed light lance with a whale-knife blade.

Having proven herself, Lucky becomes an Apprentice Whale Hunter under Atre's supervision, and soon earns the respect of the other crew members including captain Ahab.   Brave and resourceful, Lucky quickly settles into life onboard Lady Whisker, while still hiding the fact that she was a girl. After being found out however she begs Ahab to save her planet from the Federation which Ahab accepts upon learning that Moby Dick is involved.

about: Race: Vampire Height: 190 cm (6'3") Birthday: December 5 Blood type: A Affiliation: Vampires Section: Ferid Bathory's Faction Rank: Thirteenth Progenitor  Crowley is the thirteenth progenitor among vampires and a member of Seventh Progenitor Ferid Bathory's faction. He is willing to kill humans without hesitation and use them as bait to attract the more enemy soldiers. Crowley is almost always in the company of his aides, Horn Skuld and Seventeenth Progenitor Chess Belle. Crowley is a calm and patient vampire who enjoys fighting any opponent. Even when he is in a tight spot, he remains calm and pleasant with a smile on his face. When Ferid orders him to run across the battlefield, lets him fight for a minute, and then tells him he does not care if he lives or dies, he only looks mildly disappointed.  Whether things are interesting seems to be an important motive for Crowley's actions and movements. He joined Ferid Bathory's faction for this reason and while on the battlefield constantly exclaims when/if something impresses him with an almost childlike curiosity.  He has also displayed insight, noticing how fast humans are evolving and even deducing they can't have done it by themselves, which would mean a vampire has gone traitor. He discussed this with his aides Horn and Chess, whom he also warned about the weapons after testing the ability of one.

name: Anne Littstein
name_kanji: アンヌ・リトシュタイン
about: Anne is the personal maid-in-waiting of the Tearmoon Empire's princess, Mia Luna Tearmoon.   Being Mia's personal maid was initially a position that Anne and many others thought she wasn't deserving of due to being a commoner and a newly hired maid. The reason for Anne's appointment to this position was as a reward for her loyalty to Mia, loyalty Anne believed she lacked due to only taking the job for the money it provided. In truth, the loyalty wasn't from the current Anne, but the one of the previous timeline, who continued to serve Mia even after she was imprisoned by the revolution army and all the way till she was executed.  Anne is an incredibly clumsy individual, and a bit of an airhead, but she continues to strive forward and do her best at all times. She is grateful for everything Mia has done for her and her family, and has sworn to remain by Mia's side no matter what happens. These feelings though have caused Anne great pain when she is left behind by Mia, believing it due to her inability in certain areas, such as riding a horse. Even during these times, Anne takes it as a lesson in that these are areas she need to work on improving herself, as to not be a burden for Mia or anyone else that servers her.

He is the second son of a mercantile family, had always been a bright spark ever since he was a young boy. He’d always dreamed of becoming a government official, but it didn’t take him long to realize just how rotten to the core the Tearmoon Empire was after he began studying towards that goal. It was because of this that he truly despised those blueblooded nobles and the members of the Imperial Family, those who brag about their high-birth.  After falling for his own minds deceit on the actions of Princess Mia, he swears his undying loyalty to her, believing that she is what he had been looking for, someone who could bring the necessary changes to the Empire and allow it to prosper even more. about: Calista is a character of the day who appeared in Xatu the Future (EP236). She is a thirteenth-generation Xatu prophetess from a small village located between Ecruteak City and Mahogany Town. Calista typically announces the weather forecast.  Ash, his friends, and Team Rocket fell through one of Team Rocket's pitfall traps and discovered Calista's civilization. Calista rushed past them on her way to her next prediction ceremony and urged everyone to follow her. There, she predicted it would be a sunny day, but rain began to appear. Concerned, Calista ran back to her secret weather station. She scoured through her data again but was unable to disregard her Xatu's prediction that a great flood would arrive tomorrow. Calista faced a dilemma because she was unsure whether she should alert the town or not. In the end, she told the town that the Xatu had predicted a terrible storm.  As a result of the prediction, the villagers offered their belongings toward her three Xatu and then fled. The Xatu Teleported Calista, Ash, and his friends away from danger. Calista released the Xatu and became a weather reporter for a TV station.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

name: Senin
about: The captain is an unnamed character of the day who appeared in Hoenn Alone! (EP276). He works on a boat that travels from the Seafoam Islands to Littleroot Town. He is the final character of the day to appear in the original series.  He is very kind, and likes to get involved in his job, helping passengers on his boat with any problems they have—even to the extent of battling Team Rocket for Ash with his Machoke in the food store of his ship when Pikachu, his only Pokémon at the time, was stolen.  After a tank at the bottom of the ship broke, he was forced to stay behind to fix it while Ash went off with Officer Jenny to get Pikachu back. He promised to have it fixed by nightfall, and warned that if Ash wasn't back by then, they would have to leave without him. He was crestfallen when it appeared Ash could not make it back in time, but was pleased when Ash made it just in time.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

name: Kaidou
about: Captain Marius is a character of the day who appeared in Around the Whirlpool (EP212). Marius is a captain and fisherman who appears weathered from years on the sea.  He piloted his ship and escorted Professor Elm during his expedition through the Whirl Islands. His vast technical and navigation experience of the area also proved invaluable. Elm holds him in high esteem, though Marius is particularly modest and prefers to not brag about his accomplishments.  During the trip, Marius's boat helped rescue Ash and his friends after they had been blasted off their ferry by Team Rocket. Marius later docked his vessel at the Inland City ports to allow the kids to continue on their own journey through the Whirl Islands. He is deeply interested in Pokémon. He asked Brock about all of the gang's goals and dreams, and admired all of them deeply. Marius freely offers advice and before the group left for their next destination, he reminded them to enjoy the journeys towards their individual goals.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

name: Milk Delivery Man
about: Carter is a character of the day who appeared in Bulbasaur...the Ambassador! (EP227).  While on their way to Ecruteak City, Ash and his friends were nearly bowled over by some runaway milk cans. Carter called out to the group, who went onto stop the milk cans from rolling any further downhill. Thanks to Ash and the others, Carter recovered his milk cans and loaded them back in his truck. When he heard that they were going to Ecruteak City, he informed them that he was heading there as well. He offered them a ride in a blimp, and with provided tickets the group accepted. The blimp landed near Moomoo Ranch. After the ride, Ash and his friends said goodbye to Carter and continued onto Ecruteak.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

name: Daizou
about: Daizou is a character of the day who appeared in Takin' It on the Chinchou (EP214). He lives with his son in Blue Lagoon on Blue Point Isle.  He, along with his son, Dayton, were in charge of an annual Parade of the Chinchou held in Blue Lagoon. During the parade, Daizou, Dayton, Ash and his friends were at a pier at Blue Lagoon where Daizou blew a Chinchou whistle which caused the Chinchou at the lake at Blue Lagoon to glow.  It is a tradition that the Chinchou from Blue Lagoon migrate to the other side of Blue Point Isle to start a new life in the sea. Dayton, Daizou and Ash and his friends accompanied the Chinchou in doing so. When they arrived at a bridge hanging over a cliff, Team Rocket arrived on the other side to steal the Chinchou. Daizou and everyone else (save for Ash) ran for their safety, but the bridge was destroyed by Team Rocket's gizmo as it missed its goal in capturing the Chinchou. Daizou, Misty, Brock and the multiple Chinchou got separated from Ash and Dayton.  They eventually found each other on a beach at the other side of Blue Point Isle, until Team Rocket arrived once more, trapping the Chinchou in a pit. They managed to free themselves from Team Rocket's cage with Pikachu finishing Team Rocket off. After seeing the Chinchou leave for the sea, Dayton and Daizou said their farewells to Ash and his friends.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

name: Daiki
about: Dayton is a character of the day who appeared in Takin' it on the Chinchou (EP214). He lives with his father Daizou in Blue Lagoon on Blue Point Isle.  He and his father were in charge of the annual Parade of the Chinchou in Blue Lagoon. With his own Chinchou, nicknamed Bright, leading the way, Dayton journeyed with Ash so they could reach the shore. The parade party was split into two after Team Rocket attempted to snatch all of the Chinchou, but instead they destroyed the route's connecting rope bridge. Dayton ordered the Chinchou to use Thunder Wave, and afterwards Ash's Pikachu sent the trio blasting off. Dayton lead his half of the parade through a mountainous section, during which he lost his footing and fell down the side of the mountain. Bright, along with the other Chinchou, detected where he was by using their antennae and the procession continued.  He and Ash finally reached the shore the following morning, but Team Rocket attempted to steal all of the Chinchou again. Ash had a hard time freeing them with his own Pokémon because Weezing's Smokescreen had obscured his accuracy. Dayton had Bright and the other Chinchou use a Thunder Wave to cause their cage to explode, resulting in their freedom while Team Rocket was sent blasting off.  As the Chinchou were preparing to leave, Dayton approached Bright and wished it good luck on its journey and admitted that he looked forward to its return. Bright left its Trainer for a life in the seas. Dayton and his father later escorted Ash to nearby Bluefinland and watched as his new friends left aboard a ferry for Yellow Rock Isle.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

name: Yakeishi
about: Egan is a character of the day who appeared in Some Like it Hot (EP242).  Egan is a Fire-type Trainer, and like Misty, he wanted to catch and raise only Pokémon of his preferred type. As a result, he wanted a giant Magcargo that was blocking Ash and his friends' path towards Blackthorn City. However, the Magcargo was very powerful, and Egan's first attempt to battle it ended in failure.  His impulsive behavior and sharp comments sparked an intense rivalry with Misty over whether Fire-types or Water-types were the best. Over lunch, Misty decided to settle their differences, and the pair began to get along. Egan had a rematch against the Magcargo and, after heeding Misty's advice of adaptability in a match, defeated and caught it. Misty and Egan teamed up to defeat Team Rocket with a combined Flamethrower and Water Gun attack.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

name: Electric Company Head of Security

about: The electric company is a company that was mentioned in Current Events (EP201). Their head of security is a character of the day, and the only company representative seen during the episode. They operate a wind turbine facility between Ecruteak City and Olivine City.  Brock called the Electric company to inform them that Ash was trapped inside their facility, and their electric lock was broken. Team Rocket, who had first entered the facility were responsible for the broken security lock, and Ash later entered out of curiosity. The head of security arrived later and managed to repair the security lock, allowing herself, Brock and Misty to locate Ash. The search party exited the power plant after noticing Ash running outside. The head of security and Ash's friends rushed outside in time to see Ash's Chikorita evolve into Bayleef. After Bayleef freed herself and the plant's Electabuzz, together the Pokémon sent Team Rocket flying.  Afterwards she thanked Ash and Bayleef for helping to defeat Team Rocket. Jigglypuff appeared and lulled everyone to sleep with its melodic Singing, and in anger it scribbled on everyone's faces including the head of security and her Electabuzz.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

name: Kenji Natsume
about: Birthdate: July 20 Blood type: B  Height: 178cm Weight: 61kg Position: Shooting Guard/Small Forward  Tobi's history is fairly tragic in that he was forced to persevere through incredibly tough times in the past. His passion for the game of basketball is so high that no one can understand it. His skills with the ball are top level naturally gifted; his ball control, dribble, and his jump shoot are next the level.  After his father died, he and his sister went to live with a foster family, but he never approved his stepfather. He was always fighting and was never happy after his parent's death. The ball that he always carries with him was a present from his father for his birthday. He never actually received the gift from his father. He actually received it from the people that found his father's body three days before his birthday. He fights with anyone that maltreating his ball.  He loves his sister very much, and she is the only supporter he believes in. He promised her that he would win the state championship just for her.  He joined the team after Sora's continuing pursuit and dedication and through the understanding of the other teammates.  Note: Kenji's appearance is strikingly resembles the real life NBA player Allen Iverson, which Kenji seems to be based off of, especially noted with Allen Iverson-type shooting sleeves and tattoos, but most of all, the trademark hair which are cornrows. When Kenji is not playing, he has his hair is undone (just like Iverson). He also has amazing handles and explodes to the basket with great speed, which is also how Iverson played.

about: The main protagonist, an Izumo Priestess. She was found beneath the tori of Izumo Grand Shrine and raised by the head priest there.  Her temple was massacred and so she escaped and ended up being saved by Saizo. After that she decides to follow him.   She's a big eater, and her favorite foods are soba noodles and sweets. She seems to have taken a liking to Saizo, after he saved her and even asks Yukimura to let him stay with them, much to Saizo's dismay.  She also has the most optomistic personality out of everyone. Isanami went through a break through after talking to Anastasia, thus realizing even though she has no skill, she has the biggest heart. Isanami then wishes to become stronger, no longer wanting to burden everyone.

name: Anastasia

She targeted Yukimura but was defeated, so she decided to join him. Both Saizo and Sasuke call her "Ana."  She is very playful and cunning in nature, but also becomes serious when the moment calls for it.

name: Shin-Woo Han
name_kanji: 한 신우 / 田代 裕介
about: Han Shin-Woo is a student in Ye Ran High School and is popular because of his excellent martial skills. On the day of Rai's awakening, he happens to meet him on the way to school and gradually becomes close to Rai at school, developing a bond which can be termed as friendship. Eventually he gets involved in many strange fights against people with extra-ordinary powers. Rai and Frankenstein rescue him and others from the mess every time. Later he as well as the others are brainwashed for their own safety and so remember nothing of the strange happenings.  Shin-Woo is an energetic and athletic teenager with bright red hair. He is always seen with a bandage over the bridge of his nose. He is actually pretty good looking but not that many people realize it because of his behavior.  He is well-known within the city to be skilled in martial arts and feared by gangs. Shin-Woo is often shown sleeping (and drooling) in class and slacking off. Though he is shown as a lazy student, he is also very courageous and would protect his friends at all costs. He often tends to be late for school due to over sleeping.  He has liked Yuna for a long time and it is disclosed that he confessed to her in past which led to an embarrassing situation. Since then they have been just good friends although Shin-Woo still has a liking for Yuna. Shin-Woo is also starting to like Seira.  Shin-Woo is an amazing Martial Artist excelling in Tae Kwon Do and Hapkido. He is well-known within the city to be skilled in martial arts and is feared by gangs. He is able to match the powers of M-24's Infected, and since then has been getting stronger.  Even for normal human parameters, it's been quoted that Shin-Woo possesses an incredible amount of strength, which he has displayed during his multiple battles; including those with the Infected.  It's been noted that one of Shin-Woo's most incredible attributes is his speed, shown as he instantly disappeared when he went to aid Yuna right after she yelled for help. Alongside his speed, his agility and reflexes have increased during the progression of the series; to the point he was able to dodge one of Shark's attacks and counterattack at the same time.  Shin-Woo's most incredible strength relies in his durability, since he is able to endure attacks that would normally kill a human being; as shown when he took a beating from Shark and was even able to stood up against him one more time right after he threatened to kill his friends.  (Source: Noblesse Wikia)

name: Woo Ik-Han
about: Height: 157 cm  Woo Ik-Han is a regular human and best friends to Shinwoo, Yuna and Suyi, in addition to Regis, Seira and Rai. He spends most of his free time on his computer. He wears spectacles.  A running gag throughout the Manhwa is Ikhan's worry about his relatively short height. Initially, when Regis and Seira joined his class at school, Ikhan showed extreme interest in the new students, which others supposed was Ikhan developing a crush on Seira. However, it is later revealed that Ikhan was rather enraptured by Regis, for Ikhan stated that he always wanted a fellow 'short' friend. Throughout his adventures, Ikhan is seen giving Regis foods and candies that are long and thin (such as Pocky) stating that he and Regis must eat them to grow taller (a pun on the stature of the food).  His hacking and computing skills are extremely proficient. He was able to match Tao's speeds when Tao tried to hack into Ikhan's uncle's police databases. He is also the best when it comes to computer games as it is mentioned by Shinwoo that Ikhan defeated him every time. Ikhan also shows to be quite brainy rather than brawny, taking school very seriously compared to Shinwoo.  (Source: Noblesse Wikia)

Perhaps this is what Buddhists mean by "true strength lies in the absence of desire."  (Source: Onmyoji Wiki)

name: Olruggio
nicknames: Master Olly, Olruggio of the Torch, Predis Olruggio, Star of Ghodrey
about: Gender: Male Birthday: September 20 Hair: Black Eyes: Dark Blue Occupation: Watchful Eye Affiliation: Pointed Cap Witches Residence: Qifrey's Atelier, Ghodrey (Previously) Specialty: Fire Magic Status:   Olruggio is the Watchful Eye for Qifrey's atelier. He has a gruff way of speaking, but his magic is often described as "warm."  He has created a lot of contraptions, such as the Glowstone Path, the Snugstone and the Searneedle Wand etc, and is well known among his fellow witches for his inventions.  While he initially comes off as blunt and harsh, Olruggio is a genuinely kind and caring person. He looks after Qifrey and the students of the atelier, coming up with magical items to help them sleep and helping the students with their magic.   This kindness doesn’t just apply to people Olruggio knows— he helps out local villagers so frequently that the nobility of said villages and cities take note and seem almost jealous. Olruggio’s kindness towards others forces him to begin to question the laws of witch society, specifically laws against witches practicing medicine and introducing non-witches to magic. Whenever someone brings up Olruggio’s warm actions, he tries to brush it off as something anyone would do or simply part of his work as a Watchful Eye.  Olruggio is notoriously bad with deadlines and overworks himself, staying up late at night to finish commissions. He is often tired and sometimes shows a haggard face with dark circles. Due to these bad habits, he sometimes sleeps on the couch of the Atelier, oversleeps, or even misses events. Despite this, he insists on the importance of sleep to Qifrey's apprentices.  He is easily flustered and will lie about not liking praise. While at first he loudly opposed the girls calling him their professor, he stops complaining about it during the story, only occasionally telling other people they are not his pupils.     During his time in the Great Hall as an apprentice, Olruggio meets Qifrey and the two become fast friends. Olruggio helps Qifrey with his investigations into the Brimmed Caps, later helping him conquer the Tower of Tomes, though not managing to enter the library himself. Eventually, the two of them move out of the Great Hall and into Qifrey's Atelier. Olruggio helps Qifrey find his apprentices, and is present during their first encounter with Richeh.   Brushbuddy is fond of him. He's seen playing with the creature, who also climbs on him, and rocks around happily when he comes back in the Great Hall.  According to a sketch page by Shirahama Kamome, Olruggio enjoys strong yet sweet alcoholic drinks.  The diamond design featured on Olruggio's cap is also worn by many other Ghodrey citizens, such as a younger Utowin and his father.   Olruggio uses the rough-sounding, Japanese male pronoun 俺 (ore)  (Source: Witch Hat Atelier Independent Wiki)  No voice actors have been added to this character. name: Yuu Kirino
about: Yu Kirino is the NPC created by Akira Oono (Kunai Hakuto) of the series Maou-sama, Retry!. A woman cold like ice, Yu is truly sadistic and cruel who seeks knowledge about the body by cutting and dissecting all that fall into her hands. She got popularity from a number of masochistic players in the game. Yu is a prodigy doctor and a scientist. She has a sadistic personality and the hobby of "clarifying the mysteries of the body", as well as spitting out philosophy, and repeatedly doing many human experiments. Yu surveyed humans scientifically, and all of her documents were meticulously detailed, logging any and all changes and reactions. On the other hand, Yu had no regard for the subtleties of humans nor their hearts, no consideration for the ideals of the privileged nor the mindsets of the meek, and no care for their places in life. She considered it a waste of brain matter to think of such things.  (Source: Maou-sama, Retry! Wiki)

about: Birthday: July 20 (Cancer) Age: 16 Likes: Aubrey, Kel, Hero, Mari, Basil, grape soda Dislikes: Heights, spiders, deep water, cherry soda, tofu Color: White Flower: "[White tulips...] Plain, simple, and bulbous... just like Omori!"  Food: Steak Family: Mari (older sister) Weapon: Steak knife,   Sunny is the main playable character of OMORI; his alter-ego/dream self Omori is the titular character of the story. Within the dream world, Omori lives in a separate area of Headspace known as White Space—a place that he has resided in for as long as he can remember, with only his sketchbook, computer, a box of tissues, and his black cat Mewo (Nyaako in the Japanese localization). When he comes out and joins his friends, he carries around a knife as a well-rounded member of the party, and can release the power of friendship to unleash a strong team attack.  Sunny is shy and extremely quiet, both in the real world and as Omori in his dreams. His emotions are very restrictive even before he spends four years as a hikikomori/shut-in, as he does not like to smile; despite that and being easily prone to anger, he still deeply cares for his old friends. He is described by others as a vivid daydreamer, a good listener, a good violin player, and having a great memory. However, Sunny lacks self-esteem and self-confidence, and feels guilt when relying on others, especially due to being the youngest of his childhood friend group.    (Source: Omori Wiki)  No voice actors have been added to this character. Help improve our database by searching for a voice actor, and adding this character to their roles .

about: Birthday: February 18 (Aquarius) Age: 16 Likes: Taking pictures, gardening, flowers, art, reading Color: Green Flower: "[Sunflowers are] called that because they always face towards the sun. name: Minoru
about: Ephraim is a character of the day who appeared in The Grass Route (EP180).  He is the son of a couple of farmers who live in a small town close to Ecruteak City. He specializes in raising Grass-type Pokémon, mainly because his parents use a large collection of Grass-type Pokémon to maintain their farm of flowers. He convinced Ash to enter his Bulbasaur in the Grass Tournament, held near where he lives.  Ash faced Ephraim in the finals of the tournament, with Ephraim using Skiploom. Skiploom almost lost, but learned Solar Beam at the last moment. It defeated Bulbasaur, and won the tournament. Ephraim's prize was a collection of Leaf Stones, which he planned on using to evolve his parents' Pokémon.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

name: Minoru's Father
about: Ephraim's parents are characters of the day who appeared in The Grass Route (EP180). They and their son Ephraim operate a farm of flowers in a small town close to Ecruteak City.  They allowed Ephraim to participate in the 45th annual Grass Tournament, which they attended to cheer him on. Their enthusiasm and gloating to the audience only embarrassed Ephraim, but he was appreciative of their support. The pair were later seen hugging as they watched their son accept the Grass Tournament's victory prizes.  Their flower business is the culmination of enjoying a slow lifestyle and their passion for Grass-type Pokémon, which also maintain their farming operation. Ephraim's parents are both optimists and happy by nature. Ephraim's father was thankful that Ash battled their son, seeing it as an invaluable training lesson. Ephraim's parents also offered to host Ash, Misty, and Brock overnight as thanks.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

name: Mysterious Thief Golonya
about: Goneff is a character of the day who appeared in The Wayward Wobbuffet (EP194). He is a master thief who robs banks, leaving nothing behind.  During a race to retrieve the key around Wobbuffet's neck, which was needed to release Ash's Pikachu from the indestructible PokéPod, Wobbuffet accidentally jumped onto Goneff's escape truck during an ongoing police pursuit. Goneff used the windscreen wipers to knock Wobbuffet off the truck, but this failed. He soon found himself surrounded by Officer Jenny and her fellow officers. Goneff tried to escape with his backup Golem hot-air balloon, but Wobbuffet accidentally knocked him out of it and into the hands of the police.  Later, Goneff escaped this time on a stolen police motorcycle. However, Wobbuffet landed in the sidecar following a freak speedboat crash. Goneff decided to take Wobbuffet hostage, tying him with rope and holing him up in a nearby abandoned building. After Goneff was surrounded by the police, Team Rocket tried to make a deal with him, offering their escape tunnel in exchange for Wobbuffet. However, he refused and used Golem to attack the trio and later Ash's Totodile when he also confronted him. Totodile hid behind Wobbuffet to avoid Golem's Tackle, prompting Wobbuffet to use Counter to protect himself. The reflected attack hurled both Goneff and Golem into the hands of officers waiting outside.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

The Gym Leader than appeared in a flashback in the next episode, where he was dedicated to protect the Dragon Holy Land. However, the original Gym Leader passed away and as a result, Dragonite volunteered to take the Gym Leader's place. Since his passing, other people, including Clair, have served as the new Gym Leader of the Blackthorn Gym.  (Source: Bulbapedia)  No voice actors have been added to this character. about: Haruno is a character of the day who appeared in Turning Over a New Bayleef (EP202). She is a gardener who lives between Ecruteak City and Olivine City.  As she and her Machoke were returning from picking wildflowers, they noticed Bayleef lying unconscious by the riverbank. She took Bayleef in, offering her a bowl of warm soup and a place to live while she waited for her Trainer. Bayleef quickly adapted to life at Haruno's place and enjoyed the company of the other Pokémon as well.  When Ash and his friends arrived at her place, Haruno quickly realized something was amiss between him and Bayleef. She offered them a place to stay while Ash and Bayleef repaired their relationship, and the group accepted. After several failed attempts to get Bayleef to rejoin him, Haruno advised Ash that friendship needs time to grow. Team Rocket then arrived and stole some of Haruno's Pokémon with their Robo-Bayleef. However, Ash quickly rescued all of the Pokémon, after which Bayleef rejoined his team.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

name: Hisashi
about: The Wobbuffet Festival crashers are characters of the day who appeared in Wobbu-Palooza! (EP175). Individually in Japanese, they are known as ツヨシ Tsuyoshi, テツヤ Tetsuya, and ヒサシ Hisashi. Their Japanese names were revealed through closed captioning, while in the closed captions for the English dub on Prime Video, they are referred to as Pretty Boy, Greaser, and Red Spikes, respectively.  The trio trains Fighting-type Pokémon. They had previously attacked the Wobbuffet Village, during which they used their Pokémon to attack the village in order to build up their strength. They were eventually repelled by Lulu and her Wobbuffet. A full year later, the three boys attacked many innocent Wobbuffet during the Wobbuffet Festival again. Even though Pokémon battles are not allowed during the Festival, Ash and his friends drove the trio out of the village with unexpected help from Team Rocket.  They each seem to resemble the Pokémon they use in both stature and hairstyle (the one with Hitmonlee having rounded hair, for example).  (Source: Bulbapedia)

name: Yutaka
about: Keegan is a character of the day who appeared in The Stolen Stones! (EP192). He and his older sister Ramona run a courier business with the help of their Arcanine.  While he and his sister were traveling to deliver some Fire Stones for an upcoming Fire-type Pokémon contest, they rescued Ash and his friends from a rock-slide. After becoming acquainted with the group, Keegan and Ramona offered them a lift aboard their Arcanine as they were heading towards a city near Olivine City.  Keegan later tried to teach Ash how to command and ride on his Arcanine after Ash showed a lot of interest. However, he had a hard time learning how to be one with the Arcanine. Soon, the Fire Stones that he and his sister had to deliver were stolen by Team Rocket. The group split up, with Keegan and Ash deciding to pursue Jessie. They followed her right to a battlefield. She gave her word that she would give the stones back if Ash defeated her in a battle. Pikachu easily defeated her Arbok and she seemingly handed the stones over. However, at the moment they went to retrieve them, they fell into a pitfall trap and found out that the Fire Stones they received from Jessie were fake. Even worse, Keegan had hurt his arm in the fall.  Once out of the hole, Keegan and Ash attempted to go after Jessie once again to get the stones and Pikachu back. But as soon as Arcanine tried to take off, Keegan cringed in pain. Ash suggested that he should lead Arcanine, and Keegan agreed. Ash still had trouble leading Arcanine, but Keegan said that Ash had to become one with Arcanine like he did with Pikachu. Soon, Ash learned to lead Arcanine perfectly.  They ultimately found Team Rocket and got the stones back. Keegan and Ramona then delivered them to the competition.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

She was next seen speaking to Brock about Pokémon Breeding while Ash was practicing for the Extreme Pokémon Race.  She hosted the race alongside Mr. Shellby. During the race, Kimie witnessed Team Rocket's balloon fall onto the ranch with Arcanine freed from their net. After Ash defeated Team Rocket and won the race, Mr. Shellby rewarded Ash with a Phanpy Egg, and Kimie and her husband waved Ash and his friends goodbye.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

name: Luka's Great-Grandfather
about: Luka's great-grandfather is a character of the day who appeared in Mantine Overboard! (EP216). He was a seafaring captain of his own ship, the I.S.S. Raspberry.  He enjoyed studying Water-type Pokémon and deep-sea diving while searching for treasures. He eventually acquired a Silver Wing after twenty years of searching. One day, his ship sank following a powerful storm off the coast of Ogi City. While he and his crew survived, the Silver Wing went down with the ship. Luka's great-grandfather attempted to recover it on several occasions to prove that it existed, but the diving expeditions all failed. His legacy went on to inspire three generations of his family, including his great-granddaughter Luka.  Prior to the events of Mantine Overboard!, Luka had been searching through some family heirlooms when she uncovered a diary containing a map marked with an 'X' left by her great-grandfather. Later, she, Ash, and his friends located the remains of the I.S.S. Raspberry and recovered the Silver Wing, which was still in its chest. Afterwards, Luka began carrying the Silver Wing in a locket around her neck. Luka was able to unlock the mystery behind the Silver Wing in The Mystery is History, where it was revealed to be a feather from Lugia.  (Source: Bulbapedia)  No voice actors have been added to this character. Help improve our database by searching for a voice actor, and adding this character to their roles .

about: Marcello is a character of the day who appeared in Moving Pictures (EP189). He lives with his wife Sophia at the Sunflora Lodge, which they operate together.  Marcello and Sophia married 50 years ago and took a picture with hundreds of Sunflora. They continued this tradition for the next 49 wedding anniversaries. On their 50th anniversary, however, the weather was particularly cold and the Sunflora never appeared at the usual south slope location.  Ash was able to use his Sun Stone that he won as a prize in the Bug-Catching Contest to evolve a recently rescued Sunkern into a Sunflora. name: Hachirou
about: Marcellus is a character of the day who appeared in Octillery the Outcast (EP217). He lives in Scarlet City on Red Rock Isle.  Shortly before the Whirl Cup began, Marcellus approached Ash and his friends, requesting a battle. He wanted his Remoraid to evolve into an Octillery so he could have a strong Pokémon for the competition. Misty accepted the challenge and pitted her Corsola against Marcellus's Remoraid. She ended up losing, and Marcellus's Remoraid evolved at the end of the battle.  The next day, after the preliminary qualifying rounds, Ash and the others noticed Marcellus appeared to be sad. He revealed that he lost the preliminaries and was now out of the competition and invited the group over to his house for dinner. That night, he explained the reason why he lost: his tank full of Remoraid had treated his newly-evolved Octillery so differently and so poorly, neither had been able to concentrate on their preliminary battles and had ended up losing because of it.  Team Rocket arrived and stole all of the Remoraid with their vacuum truck. However, Octillery left an ink trail, allowing Marcellus and the others to track the trio down at a port, where they rescued the Remoraid. After saving Octillery from falling, all of the other Remoraid evolved into Octillery themselves and subsequently inducted Octillery back into their group, pleasing Marcellus.  Marcellus was last seen watching the Whirl Cup's stadium empty out its water with Ash, Misty, Brock, and the many trainers who'd made it to the main tournament.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

However, Team Rocket came by and tried to steal Doomy by firing a net at it. Ash and his friends then battled Team Rocket and freed Doomy. Like generations of great Water-type Trainers before her, she oversees the Whirl Cup competition with the magical power of the Great Sea Spirit Sapphire. It is said that she can communicate with Water-type Pokémon when she evokes the Sea Spirit Union.  She watched over the Whirl Cup in Dueling Heroes and The Perfect Match!. Maya is very confident, as was proven when Officer Jenny warned her that the Sea Spirit was about to be stolen. Maya smiled and told the officer not to worry about what may happen.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

name: Isami
about: McKenzie is a character of the day who appeared in Doin' What Comes Natu-rally (EP203).  Ash and his friends first encountered McKenzie while he was trying to train his Natu, nicknamed Naughty. When they asked what he was doing, he got scared and ran away. They soon encountered him again at a fair where Pokémon displayed their talents. McKenzie's father asked McKenzie and Naughty to look into Misty's future. However, he did the routine all wrong due to stage fright. Ash and the gang decided to help him, and Misty advised that McKenzie should wear a mask so that the audience wouldn't see his face. McKenzie was in the middle of trying out his new act when Team Rocket attacked the fair and stole Naughty, along with some other Pokémon.  He eventually got Naughty back, and after that, he used it to battle Jessie and her Arbok. All the while, an audience was watching him, but McKenzie wasn't fazed at all by it. McKenzie told Naughty to use Confuse Ray on Arbok, making it confused and go after Team Rocket as a result. Ash then ordered Pikachu to use Thunderbolt, which sent Team Rocket blasting off. McKenzie was then asked by a schoolteacher if he could put on a show for the children. He agreed and did his performance perfectly. He even felt comfortable enough to take off his mask.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

name: Isami's Father
about: McKenzie's father is a character of the day who appeared in Doin' What Comes Natu-rally (EP203). He doesn't have an official name in the original version or the dub.  He is world-famous for being a street performer in the Pokémon Street Performer Festival. He would use his Natu in order to read people's futures. When his son McKenzie wanted to be like him and help him perform, he told him he was up for anything that pleases the audience. He commended Ash and his friends for having McKenzie perform while wearing a mask to hide his face. He holds the belief that experience teaches both people and Pokémon how to grow. name: Mika
about: Mika is a character of the day and a little girl who lives in Megi City on Yellow Rock Isle with her sister, Andrea, and their father. The entire family appeared in A Corsola Caper! (EP215).  The family's business collects Corsola horns to make jewelry, the main source of income for Yellow Rock Isle. As a result, the family lives on top of a Corsola colony. This gives them easy access to the Corsola when they shed their horns.  One day, an overexcited Corsola found its way to the family. Its eagerness to play scared off all the other Corsola. Because there were no Corsola in the colony, their house floated away. Unfortunately, it carried little Mika with it. Thankfully, Ash and his friends saw what was going on and came to Mika's rescue. With the help of Bulbasaur and Bayleef, Mika was saved from drowning in a whirlpool.  She reappeared in a flashback in Espeon, Not Included (EP228).  (Source: Bulbapedia)

name: Mika & Ayano's Father
about: Mika and Andrea's father is a character of the day who appeared in A Corsola Caper! (EP215). He lives in Megi City on Yellow Rock Isle with his two daughters, Mika and Andrea.  Mika and Andrea's father arrived when Ash and his friends saved Mika from a giant whirlpool, thanking the group for doing so. He took the group to their home and showed them that he has his own jewelry shop and collected Corsola horns that were shed from Corsola themselves to make jewelry. He is assisted by Mika and Andrea in doing so. As multiple Corsola of theirs left the island, Mika and Andrea's father along with the gang returned to town.  As Team Rocket interrupted their search, he recovered the jewelry they stole and called out for the Corsola by their nicknames. With all of the Corsola found and Team Rocket defeated once again, Misty was able to capture a Corsola and the family waved their farewells to the group.  He reappeared in a flashback in Espeon, Not Included (EP228).  (Source: Bulbapedia)

name: Hassaku
about: Myron is a character of the day who appeared in Fight for the Light! (EP210). He is the grandfather of Olivine City Gym Leader Jasmine.  He helped Jasmine to take care of Sparkle when it was ill. Later, he advised Ash to challenge the Cianwood Gym before challenging Jasmine, to give her time to get ready for battle.  Myron commended Janina, Jasmine's Gym apprentice, and her quick thinking after she used her Onix as a rope to stop Team Rocket from escaping with Sparkle. His accolades helped Jasmine trust Janina after she pretended to be the Olivine Gym Leader and coated her Onix in wax to give it an unfair advantage in battle.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

name: Narumi
about: Naomi is a character of the day who appeared in Lapras of Luxury (EP259). She is a Pokémon researcher studying communication between Water-type Pokémon, specifically Lapras. She is the director and sole employee of the Marine Pokémon Laboratory.  She was studying the pod of Lapras that Ash's Lapras belonged to. Thanks to Ash and his Lapras, Naomi was able to discover that the herd came from the Orange Islands, something she hadn't known before.  After Team Rocket had netted the Lapras herd, Naomi ordered Ash and his friends into her submarine, the S.S. Innocent Coral, to follow after them. She used Ash's Lapras's own singing to track the caught herd, which led her to a wall of riptides and later an island where Team Rocket had stopped to catch their breaths. While Brock's Crobat dealt with Team Rocket's Pokémon, Naomi helped free the Lapras from the capture net.  Later, Naomi reported back to Professor Elm that Ash's contributions will help her to complete her thesis on Lapras migration patterns. She handed Ash the Pokémon Egg to be delivered to Elm before they left her lab.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

name: Nario
about: Norio is a character of the day who appeared in Wobbu-Palooza! (EP175). He is a resident of the Wobbuffet Village, and loves Wobbuffet as much as everyone else who lives in the village. His name in the English dub was only revealed through the closed captions available on Prime Video.  He was outraged when he heard someone had started attacking the Wobbuffet in the village, and like Ash, Misty and Brock, whom he just recently met, quickly pointed the finger at Team Rocket.  He recalled a story of last year's Wobbuffet Festival, when Wobbuffet were attacked too to Ash and his friends. A resident named Lulu beat the attackers with her own Wobbuffet. With the new attack, he went to find her and Officer Jenny. He then brought them to the scene where the Festival crashers showed up once again.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

name: Park Warden
about: The park warden is a character of the day who appeared in One Trick Phony! (EP250). He is in charge of the Battle Park.  He brought Team Rocket, who was working at the battle facility, more boxes of dirty Poké Balls for cleaning and laughed off their disdain, saying he had the hard task of shopping and left Team Rocket in charge of the park while he went to get supplies.  Later, when Team Rocket flew off with the Poké Balls and Ash's Pikachu, the warden ran out telling them that the Poké Balls belong to the Battle Park. After Ash's Totodile and Misty's Politoed brought down their balloon, Jessie and James sent out Venusaur, Charizard, and Blastoise to battle Ash and his friends. However, the rental Pokémon turned on them, as they were only obedient inside the park and blasted the trio off.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

name: Phony Pokémon Interpreters Boss
about: The phony Pokémon interpreters are four characters of the day who appeared in The Poké Spokesman (EP197). They served as the main antagonists of the episode.  The fake interpreters were running a fake Pokémon interpreter scam in which they profited off of their fake services. The authorities caught on to their scheme, and Officer Jenny was preparing to arrest Simon, a practicing Pokémon interpreter who appeared to match the police report descriptions. However, the fake interpreters fired missiles at Simon, Ash, and his friends, blinding them and allowing them to kidnap Simon. They wanted him to join their group, believing he was a fraud like them. Despite their threats, Simon refused since he felt their actions were wrong, and he later escaped.  After Simon checked up on Ash's Pikachu to see if he was okay, the fake interpreters showed up again at the Pokémon Center with their Magnemite and Magneton. In an extortion attempt, the leader ordered his gang's Pokémon to absorb the Center's electricity. They ignored Nurse Joy's pleas, but Simon's ability to communicate with Pokémon led the Magnemite and Magneton to stop their attack. Infuriated, the leader decided to kick Magnemite in order to teach it a lesson. However, Pikachu energized the Magnemite and Magneton with an Electric attack, allowing the Magnet Pokémon to attack their Trainers. Afterwards, the fake interpreters were arrested by Officer Jenny.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

name: Doctor Telesu
about: Professor Telesu is a character of the day who appeared in A Crowning Achievement (EP262).  He is an archaeologist who was studying hieroglyphics near a lake full of Slowpoke that suffered a drought after an earthquake. According to the hieroglyphics, a Slowpoke needed to evolve into a Slowking to save the colony, but the Shellder in the lake kept on latching on to the Slowpoke and causing them to evolve into Slowbro. His daughter's Slowpoke was able to make it, and was intelligent enough to lead the Slowpoke and Slowbro into an underground cave where water was plentiful.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

name: Haruka
about: Ramona is a character of the day who appeared in The Stolen Stones! (EP192). She and her younger brother Keegan run a courier business with the help of their Arcanine.  Ash and his friends first met Ramona when she and Keegan saved them from a rock-slide with the help of their Arcanine. Brock was impressed that Ramona could control a tough Pokémon so easily and began flirting with her immediately after.  Ramona and her brother were traveling to a city near Olivine City to deliver Fire Stones, which were to be handed out as prizes for a Fire-type Pokémon competition. However, the Fire Stones were stolen by Team Rocket. To recover the stones, Ramona, Brock, and Misty went after James, while Ash and Keegan pursued Jessie. However, Ramona's group fell in a pitfall trap and remained there until Brock used his Onix to get them out.  They soon found Team Rocket again and Ramona commanded her two Arcanine to use Fire Spin on their balloon, sending them crashing to the ground. Ramona got the Fire Stones back and she and Keegan delivered them to the competition headquarters on time.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

name: Mutou
about: Ranger Mason is a character of the day who appeared in Mother of All Battles (EP266).  Mason is one of the Pokémon Rangers in charge of protecting a Pokémon preserve on Mt. Silver. It is the same preserve where the Pokémon Poacher Brothers kidnapped Ash's Larvitar when it was just an Egg and severely wounded the Tyranitar that was Larvitar's mother.  Mason made it her mission to stop the poachers from hurting any more Pokémon. With the help of Ash and his friends, Mason was able to track down the poachers and capture them once and for all. Larvitar was successfully reunited with its mother. Mason thanked Ash and his friends for taking care of Larvitar and helping her capture the brothers, and they continued their journey to the Silver Conference.  In Tie One On! (EP270), Professor Elm called Ash with an update from Ranger Mason, saying Larvitar and its mother were doing well.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

name: Solicitor Old Lady
about: The Rocket Scout is a character of the day who appeared in Dues and Don'ts (EP233). Her job is to find worthy candidates for Team Rocket members.  The Scout recruited Jessie, James, and Meowth back into Team Rocket after looking in the computer system and realizing they weren't in it. When the trio discovered that their membership with Team Rocket had expired, they were shocked.  Initially, she presented them with a Delibird in a cage with a recorded message, claiming that she had "caught ever so many of this Pokémon", so she was "leaving it here" for them to catch. After they defeated it, she asked them to join the real Team Rocket, as they were clearly "fake, phony frauds". After an evaluation of their membership cards, she informed them of how they had not paid the necessary dues and had been booted out of Team Rocket altogether.  After they decided to rejoin, she informed them that they must defeat a group of Trainers before joining and, coincidentally, selected Ash and his friends as candidates. Even after using the help of Delibird, Jessie and James were defeated in battle. After their defeat, she decided that they could still join, as Team Rocket was already suffering from a lack of members.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

name: Saburou
about: Salvador is a character of the day and a Pokémon Trainer from Cherrygrove City.  Salvador appeared in A Claim to Flame!, as Ash's first opponent during the Screening Round of the Silver Conference. The computer randomly selected Ash to go first, and Salvador sent out his Furret to battle Ash's Pikachu. Furret turned out to be a tough opponent, though Ash ultimately won and advanced onto the next stages. It is not known if Salvador won his other two battles in the Screening Round, and therefore it is not known if he moved on in the Silver Conference.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

name: Senichi
about: Satchel is a character of the day who appeared in You're a Star, Larvitar!.  Satchel asked Ash if he wanted to battle, and Ash accepted, saying he wanted to prepare for the Silver Conference. Satchel sent out his Magby and Ash, wanting to literally fight fire with fire, sent out his Cyndaquil. Although Cyndaquil put up a good fight, Magby ended up defeating it.  When Ash complimented Satchel on how strong it was, he said that he was trying to evolve it into a Magmar. He agreed that it was strong, but said that as a Magby, it wouldn't last half a round in the Silver Conference.  Satchel's goal was accomplished when Team Rocket attacked and stole many Trainers' Pokémon. After Larvitar helped to save them, Satchel used Magby to attack Team Rocket. After it began to get the upper hand, it evolved into Magmar and sent Team Rocket blasting off.  As Ash and Satchel parted ways, they both hoped that they would battle each other in the Silver Conference. However, that never happened, and Satchel hasn't been seen since.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

name: Tamazou
about: Mr. Shellby is a character of the day who appeared in Extreme Pokémon!.  Mr. Shellby lives in the town of Eggseter with his wife. They own the Shellby Ranch, and call themselves Pokémon Nesters; people who take care of Pokémon Eggs, as well as the babies after they hatch until they become older to care for themselves.  In addition to working at the Ranch, the Shellbys also help out during the town's annual Extreme Pokémon competition. All competitors in the race must pick up a dummy Egg at the Shellby Ranch and carry it back to the finish line. Ash was successfully able to do this. As a reward for this, and as a thank you from the Shellbys for saving their Pokémon, they gave him an Egg that hatched into a Phanpy.  He was mentioned by Ash and Brock in Hatching a Plan.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

name: Master Shonosuke
about: Shonosuke is a character of the day who appeared in Ring Masters. He is the host of the annual Sumo Conference.  Ash and his friends first met him after walking through Rikishii Town and noticing Raiden and his Feraligatr training at a local facility. His knowledge and passion for the sport inspired Ash to compete. He watched over the entire tournament, and used his high-ranking position to protest the referee's ruling that "Jessiyaki" and her Wobbuffet, disguised as a Miltank, won against an Ursaring. Team Rocket's cover was blown after Shonosuke disqualified them for using the move Counter. After their defeat, the tournament continued on, and he later presented Ash with the Sumo Conference title and winning prizes.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

name: Lang
about: Simon is a character of the day who appeared in The Poké Spokesman. He has the ability to interpret the feelings of Pokémon.  Simon revealed that, sixty years prior, a twister hit, and his father put him in a storm cellar. During this time, Simon met a trio of wild Pokémon, who were also seeking refuge from the storm, and struck up a conversation with them. Since then, he considered the event to be the most magical day of his life. As an adult, Simon set up a rest stop somewhere between Ecruteak City and Olivine City.  Simon approached Ash and his friends after noticing that Ash's Pikachu was weak. He informed Ash that the minerals in the ground were causing Pikachu to lose electricity, and spoke with Pikachu further on the matter. He invited the group back to his rest stop, where Pikachu could be recharged.  During their stay, they were visited by Officer Jenny, who believed Simon was a fraud after a string of reports about a con artist matched his description. When she was about to arrest him, missiles were fired outside, causing a smokescreen that blinded everyone while Simon was kidnapped by a group of fake Pokémon interpreters. They recruited Simon to join their cause, but he refused, saying what they were doing was wrong. However, they pressed on, feeling he was a fake interpreter just like them.  Simon eventually left them in order to check on Pikachu, who had to be rushed to the Pokémon Center after inhaling the smoke caused by the missiles. Simon's abilities were finally proven real when the fake interpreters sent out their Magnemite and Magneton to absorb the electricity at the Pokémon Center. He was able to explain to Magnemite and Magneton that they were hurting the other Pokémon inside. They subsequently stopped feeding on the electricity and attacked their Trainers, allowing Officer Jenny to arrest them. She thanked Simon for saving the Pokémon Center and acknowledged his abilities as real.  The following day, Simon told Ash and his friends that he was going to stop interpreting Pokémon, though they encouraged him to pursue his endeavors. Later, Meowth, who appreciated Simon's abilities and attempts to communicate with Pokémon, staged a fake talking Pokémon encounter in order to encourage Simon into continuing his operation.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

name: Lang's Father
about: Simon's father is a character of the day who appeared in The Poké Spokesman. His only appearance in the episode was in Simon's flashback.  When Simon was young, he was rescued by his father when a tornado struck their homeland. Simon's father put his son in the basement for his own safety as he went to check on the neighbors. During Simon's time in the cellar, he discovered he had the ability to speak to Pokémon. After the storm stopped, Simon's father retrieved his son from the storm cellar. While the pair were uninjured in the natural disaster, their farmhouse was devastated by the strong winds.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

about: An enthusiast and supporter of the British Empire. After the fire incident in the British library, he was entrusted by the British library to guard "The Book of Pulsating Flesh." He lives in a Romanian castle together with his faithful servant, Irving. The castle exterior and interior were specially design to detect disturbance from a certain distance and at the same time emit frequency on its own. As shown in TV series, he is an expert in sound and frequency where he uses a special pipe organ (also known as a frequency organ) to transmit various frequency to control mammals, manipulate people's emotions and create a semi-visible shield to protect himself. He holds a grudge against Yomiko Readman since she was responsible for the fire in the British Library. Though he proves to be a challenge to the Paper Sisters, he is defeated when the Paper Sisters create a paper "silencer" field which allows them to bypass his protection field.  (Source: Wikipedia)

When he was a middle school student, he belonged to the kendo club, and his tactics to break through his opponent's defense were excellent, so his reputation in the club was high. about: Sophia is a character of the day who appeared in Moving Pictures, She lives with her husband of 50 years, Marcello, at the Sunflora Lodge, which they run together.  Sophia and Marcello married 50 years ago and took a picture with hundreds of Sunflora. They continued this tradition for the next 49 wedding anniversaries. On their 50th anniversary, however, the weather was particularly cold and the Sunflora never appeared at the usual south slope location.  Ash was able to use his Sun Stone that he won as a prize in the Bug-Catching Contest to evolve a recently rescued Sunkern into a Sunflora. This Sunflora went on to call the other Sunflora over, allowing Sophia and Marcello to maintain their anniversary tradition, and Todd took the commemorative snapshot.  Sophia enjoys telling travelers romantic stories about herself and Marcello. However, these tales aren't completely true and are inspired by the many romance novels and movies she enjoys.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

name: Saiga
about: Steven is a character of the day who appeared in Whichever Way the Wind Blows. He is a scientist who explained to Ash, Misty and Brock the evolution process of Gloom into Bellossom or Vileplume.  After Ash and his friends broke up the fighting between Vileplume and Bellossom the first time with Bayleef's Vine Whip, Steven ran up to them and thanked them for doing so. He explained to the group about Oddish's branched evolutions. When one set of Gloom evolved into Vileplume and another set into Bellossom, Steven gave the group masks so they wouldn't inhale their Stun Spore.  Steven deduced the fact that a giant tree that the Vileplume and Bellossom shared was the cause of their fighting. The tree was the only source of shade. Steven than explained that when the tree covers the area the Bellossom are in, they go to the Vileplume's side and vice-versa for the Vileplume going to the Bellossom's side, causing an infinite loop as they both need the sunlight.  Later, Steven warned Ash, Misty, and Brock about heavy winds heading their direction. Inside the laboratory, they noticed the winds caused Gloom to evolve into Vileplume and Bellossom. After the storm stopped, Steven went outside with the group and allowed the fighting to occur to prove that fighting doesn't solve anything.  Team Rocket appeared and tried to capture the brawling Vileplume and Bellossom but were Stun Spored. The trio went for the Vileplume and Bellossom that got along instead but were blasted off by Bayleef's Vine Whip. Steven saw that all of the Vileplume and Bellossom got along afterwards. He waved his goodbyes to Ash, Misty, and Brock.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

name: Nabi
about: Tammy is a young girl and a character of the day who appeared in I Politoed Ya So!. She is the leader of a Pokémon cheerleading troupe.  Her Politoed, nicknamed Bean, ran off after she scolded it for not performing properly. During her search, she stumbled across Misty's Politoed, after which Tammy decided she liked the latter more and hoped to use it for the upcoming National Competition. Meanwhile, Misty and her friends encountered Bean, though Misty was certain that it was not her own Politoed, which she later discovered practicing a cheer routine with Tammy.  After Politoed ran back to Misty, Tammy asked if she could borrow it, but Misty saw that Tammy was particularly harsh towards all of her own Pokémon, furiously yelling at them for every mistake. As a result, her own Politoed had become withdrawn and morose. Misty eventually called Tammy out on her selfish and immature actions. Tammy watched as Misty tended to her crying Pokémon, and she realized she had become fixated on winning as opposed to her actual goal of entertaining crowds. She apologized to her Pokémon, who forgave her.  Team Rocket later showed up at Tammy's dance school and captured most of the group using their cheerleading Politoed mecha. Ash, Pikachu, and Bean intervened, with Bean rescuing everyone before Pikachu used Thunderbolt to send Team Rocket blasting off. Afterwards, Tammy reunited with Bean and was pleased to see that it had picked up Misty's Politoed's own clapping rhythm.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

name: Tatsuo
about: Tatsuo is a character of the day who appeared in Wobbu-Palooza!. He is a man who lives in Wobbuffet Village.  His Wobbuffet was attacked by the Wobbuffet Festival crashers, during the Wobbuffet Festival, and he was the third person of the village whose Wobbuffet was attacked. The Wobbuffet Festival Crashers attacked and defeated Tatsuo's Wobbuffet right in front of the other Wobbuffet Village citizens. Afterwards, Ash, his friends and Norio arrived on the scene and took over the fight.  (Source: Bulbapedia)  No voice actors have been added to this character. Help improve our database by searching for a voice actor, and adding this character to their roles .

name: Himeka's Father
about: Temacu's father is a character of the day who appeared in The Heartbreak of Brock. He is the father of Temacu and a Pokémon Professor.  When Temacu fell in love with Brock for saving her from falling in the water fountain, her father went to Ash and his friends as he saw that Temacu had an interest in Brock. After that, he took the group to his laboratory in order to stay over for dinner and tea. The following day, he took the group through his laboratory, admitting that he would be expanding his facility to be able to host 100 different Pokémon. Later, when Team Rocket attacked the laboratory and stole his Pokémon. After the Smokescreen cleared, his Pokémon were still at the lab, but his daughter was missing. He quickly assembled a search party including Ash and his friends to locate Temacu.  Team Rocket were initially annoyed that they had only caught Temacu, but decided to use her affection for James to steal her father's Pokémon. James and Jessie disguised themselves as Temacu's fiance and maid of honor, respectively. With a fake story and Temacu's blind love, he invited the trio into his home without any suspicions. Jessie and Meowth were quick to steal a bag full of Poké Balls from his store room. Even though the heist was interrupted, Temacu's father hadn't realized that his daughter's guests had stolen from him until Ash's group arrived and revealed Team Rocket's true identities. Team Rocket attempted to flee with the stolen Poké Balls, but Ash's group stopped them.  After Team Rocket's defeat, Temacu's father revealed to the group that Temacu had been wanting to get married ever since she attended her cousin's wedding. He then bid farewell to the group as they headed off to the next town.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

name: Tenma
about: Tenma is a character of the day who appeared in The Big Balloon Blow-Up. He is Skyler's father. Tenma works inside an air hangar specializing in designing, creating, and flying hot-air balloons.  Tenma lent Ash and his friends a Pikachu balloon to use for the upcoming Pokémon Balloon Race, and then explained the rules and aim of the sport. He competed alongside Skyler in the race, and he also coached Ash and his friends through a large gust of wind via walkie-talkie.  The two teams ultimately came in first place, but Ash and his friends were honored by the experience and gave the win to Tenma and his son.  Skyler described Tenma as both an architect and an artist at the same time. Tenma keeps pictures on his studio's walls of all of his Pokémon-inspired creations. He and his son share a passion for hot-air ballooning, and both support each others ambitions.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

name: Natsuki
about: Tierra is a character of the day who appeared in Control Freak!. She is an archaeologist trying to find a secret chamber in which a magical mask and staff, which had the power to control the minds of Pokémon, was supposedly located.  Brock's Golbat led the group to Tierra, who was found lying unconscious in her dig site. After recovering, Tierra invited the group to her site office, where she showed them the ancient tablet that had inspired her solo archaeological study. Meanwhile, Brock helped repair her equipment, and he upgraded her laptop to be compatible with Golbat's Supersonic waves. After learning that Tierra's digging machine had been destroyed, Brock also used his Geodude to Dig to the underground temple site.  However, Team Rocket had already reached the ancient temple first with their Dig-a-Tron. Tierra was shocked by Jessie's belligerence after she put on the mask and began to wield the scepter's power for her own purposes. Team Rocket reduced the underground temple to rubble during their escape in the mecha, though Tierra and the others emerged unscathed from the debris. After Team Rocket was blasted off by Pikachu, Tierra acquired the mask and staff to continue her research.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

name: Sukeza
about: Sukeza is a miner from Katabami Gold Mine. Sukeza lived in fear of Raiga and his men. He hated being helped by anyone because of what Raiga would do to him. He was so afraid of them that he would go as far as to beat himself up to make it look like he was attacked.  (Source: Narutopedia)

name: Hiroki
about: Timothy is a character of the day who appeared in The Dunsparce Deception.  Timothy was able to capture a Dunsparce during a massive emergence of the Land Snake Pokémon. He invited several children to a local playground and challenged Bucky, who was away during the swarm event, and his Caterpie to compete in a race against all of the other children's Dunsparce. However, Caterpie struggled against the Dunsparce and Timothy had his Pokémon fly over one of the obstacles. After Caterpie fell, Bucky took himself out of the race, while a girl scolded Timothy for humiliating him.  Timothy and the other children went to watch Team Rocket's "Moltres versus Dunsparce" performance, though they were left disappointed by the costumes and acting. After the play was over, Jessie announced that the children could trade their Dunsparce for a Moltres. Timothy was first in line, and the other children followed suit, completely unaware that it was a scheme by Team Rocket to steal all of their Pokémon. Bucky, Ash, and his friends stumbled upon the crying children, who revealed that they had been conned and received fake Poké Balls after trading away their Dunsparce.  After the situation was resolved and Bucky caught his own Dunsparce, he, Timothy, and the other children were able to play together.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

name: Toukichi
about: Toukichi is a character of the day who appeared in Ariados, Amigos. In the English dub, he was merely referred to with the title of sensei.  He is the owner of the Pokémon Jujitsu Academy that is in between Goldenrod City and Ecruteak City. When Aya came to perfect and improve her training skills, Toukichi took her under his wing and became her tutor. He and his Ariados helped Aya and her Venonat become better at battling. As well as being the owner of the academy, he partakes in many of the classes that the academy offers. In the class for improving battle techniques, he is the judge for each battle.  After Jessie, James and Meowth stole all the students' Pokémon, Tōkichi, as well as Aya and the gang, chased after them. He used his Ariados's web in order to make a kite. Aya stated to Ash that creating and utilizing the kite is one of her master's greatest techniques. Using ninja stars, he cut the balloon and cut the rope holding the stolen Poké Balls.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

name: Old Mayor of Diglett Village
about: The Town Council members are characters of the day that featured in Plant It Now...Diglett Later (EP220). The elderly people founded Diglett Village and are its local political representatives.  The members of the Town Council enlisted the assistance of Team Rocket, Ash, and his friends to stop the band of Diglett thieves from stealing the town's Diglett, which are used in the village for agriculture. However, they were unaware that the thieves were actually an intimidation tactic created by their own children, who lived in a larger town nearby.  With the help of Team Rocket and Ash's group, the Town Council members were taught how to defend themselves from the thieves. As a way of thanking Ash and his friends, the elders presented them with a Silver Wing Badge and directed the group to Silver Rock Isle.  The Town Council is a lively group that values hard work. They enjoy their dependence and are determined to maintain it, hence their refusal to move into the purpose-built retirement home.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

The Trainer let Josephine rest after the "intense battle", and recommended that Ash and his friends visit the Battle Park to practice against more Pokémon and Trainers.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

about: Trixie is a character of the day who appeared in Love, Totodile Style. She and her Pokémon are performers in a Pokémon circus.  Trixie met Ash and his friends while she was out looking for her lost Azumarill. After finding Azumarill, she informed the group that the Aqua Rabbit Pokémon had recently been behaving oddly, even refusing to perform in the circus, which deeply concerned her. She then invited everyone to her next circus performance, but it was interrupted by Ash's Totodile, who had fallen fell in love with Azumarill, who in turn wanted nothing to do with him.  After Team Rocket kidnapped Azumarill and Totodile, Trixie had her Pidgey locate Team Rocket's balloon. During the ensuing confrontation, Ash's Pokémon set the captives free. Azumarill finally expressed her love for Trixie's Golduck, which had been what was responsible for her behavioral change, much to the surprise of everyone.  (Source: Bulbapedia)
