name: Ryuunosuke Yuki
about: Yuki Ryuunosuke is one of the Shinigami that replaces Zennosuke Kurumadani as the guardian of the Karakura Town area.  Appearance: Ryuunosuke has dark hair and wears a standard Shinigami Shihakusho. He has three circular hair clips at both sides of his hair.  Personality: Ryuunosuke is a timid and soft person. He is also shown to be nervous and easily gets frightened when four large Hollows appear to attack him.  Plot: The Thousand-Year Blood War arc  On the day he is scheduled to take over guarding Karakura Town from Zennosuke Kurumadani, a sleep deprived Ryuunosuke arrives late and is told off by Zennosuke. Ryuunosuke explains that he did not sleep due to being nervous about his new assignment. Shino greets Ryuunosuke and tells him to prepare for their mission. He tells her that he is scared about the high rate of Hollows in Karakura Town. Shino scolds him over this attitude. She asks why he doesn't proudly stick out his chest. He is hit for making a comment about how she is flat chested. That evening, Ryuunosuke and Shino are brought to the Human World by Zennosuke, who leaves them after offering them some encouragement. Shino tells a reluctant Ryuunosuke to split up.  Ryuunosuke quickly finds a Hollow and runs from it, calling for Shino. However, when he finds her, she is being held by a large Hollow. Ryuunosuke draws his sword and decides to save her, but he is attacked and left lying on the ground badly injured. He is saved by Ichigo Kurosaki, who defeats the Hollow and introduces himself.  Ryuunosuke wakes up in Ichigo's room and is told he can leave. Orihime arrives, happy that he has woken up. He sits confused as Ichigo and his friends bicker. After some time he screams, noticing that Ichigo is the person he met yesterday. Ichigo comments that he is slow and corrects him saying that he has been asleep for a day. He then remembers Ichigo and the others defeating the Hollows. He is shocked that they were able to defeat the Hollows so quickly despite how strong he heard Ichigo was. Ichigo hands him some bread and tells him to get in his Gigai. Ryuunosuke comments that he shouldn't do that when Shino arrives. He is happy to see her and the two bicker with each other. The pair then look on as Ivan Azgiaro appears in the room and is promptly kicked out a window by Ichigo, wondering who he was.  He is Rikichi Yuuki's younger brother.  (Source: Bleach Wikia)

name: Shino Madarame
about: Shino is one of the Shinigami that replaces Zennosuke Kurumadani as the guardian of the Karakura Town area.  Appearance: Shino has dark hair and wears a standard Shinigami Shihakusho with a dark piece of fabric sitting on top of her head.  Personality: She is quite rude and tomboyish. She has a strong personality and expresses her thoughts by yelling. She also tries to drag Ryunosuke out of his shell and keeps telling him he shouldn't be so soft. She is quite sensitive when someone makes a remark about her flat chest and punches the culprit as punishment.  Plot: The Thousand-Year Blood War arc  On the day they are scheduled to begin guarding Karakura Town, Shino spots Ryunosuke and greets him. Ryunosuke is very sleepy and looks the wrong way, so Shino slaps Ryunosuke. She tells him to get ready to leave to the Human World, but Ryunosuke admits that he is scared. Shino says that he has no reason to be scared, as he is with her, but Ryunosuke is not convinced. She then yells at him, telling him not be a sissy and to have faith in his abilities. She says that he should stick out his chest more, prompting Ryunosuke to jokingly remark that Shino has no chest to stick out. Shino punches him in the face as a result.  The pair arrive in Karakura Town alongside Kurumadani, who leaves them after offering them some encouragement. She tells Ryunosuke to split up: she will go north, while Ryunosuke goes south. While on patrol, Shino is hit by a group of Hollows and is found in their grasp by Ryunosuke. They were rescued by Kurosaki Ichigo and Shino recovered quickly, but had to wait for Ryunosuke, who took two days to wake up. When he finally did, she seemed relieved, but punished him for taking so long immediately after. When Ivan Azgiaro appears in the room, the pair watch as Ichigo kicks him out of a window, leaving them wondering who Ivan was.  (Source: Bleach Wikia)

about: Shishou is Kino's master who taught her marksmanship. She lives in the forest and does not travel. Her actual name is unknown; "Shishou" is a title meaning "mentor" or "master" (although Kino does not realize this at first). In the final episode of the anime, which chronologically takes place before most other episodes, the gunsmith who made The Cannon told Kino he gave the gun to a young woman who insisted everyone call her "Shishou." She traveled between countries and stirred up trouble wherever she went, meaning that Shishou was once a traveler.  In the novels, multiple stories are devoted to her travels alongside a man referred to as her "student," when she was in her late twenties. She and her student are shown as being incredibly greedy, even to the point of being cruel. They travel in a battered yellow car.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Sakurako Sanjou
about: Sakurako was the object of torment of the children she went to school with because she was born "ugly". When she confessed her love to Domyouji, he traumatized her by making fun of her looks. She was friend's with Makiko when they were still in Elementary school, but moved to Germany because of her family's business. Sakurako undergoes plastic surgery and returns to Eitoku, determined to use her new beauty to take her revenge on Domyouji by making him fall in love with her. She met Tsukushi when she asked for help at Shizuka's birthday party. She acts sweet and innocent, but lets her true colors show when she thinks no one is watching. When she hears of his growing attraction to Tsukushi, she conspires with her friend Thomas to destroy her. She has Thomas drug Tsukushi at a club and then distributes photos of the two of them in bed together around the school, causing the student body to turn on her for betraying Domyouji. When Tsukushi finds out that Sakurako is behind of this, Sakurako tells Tsukushi that she only used her in order to take revenge on Tsukasa and that she doesn't need any friends and says that ugly and average people like Tsukushi shouldn't be near handsome men like those in the F4. When Domyouji eventually refuses Sakurako's advances and sees through her plans, Sakurako becomes remorseful. She is then bullied by the whole student body because of her plastic surgery, but Tsukushi defends her. Tsukushi then says that she still can't forgive her. Sakurako also takes advantage of the situation to be near with Tsukasa when Tsukasa breaks up with Tsukushi because of her romance with Rui. But Tsukasa only pretends to be close with Sakurako to make Tsukushi jealous. At first, it's unknown whether Sakurako and Tsukushi can still be friends or not, because Sakurako becomes cruel when she is with Tsukasa. But, as the story progresses, Sakurako seems to be more friendly and sometimes defends Tsukushi from other people with malicious intent.  (Source: Wikipedia)

about: Ryou Sugawa is a recurring character in the Baka to Test to Shoukanjuu series. He is a student in Class 2-F in Fumizuki Academy and is the leader of the FFF Inquisition. Aside from the major characters in Class 2-F, his face is visible normally, and he is the only one outside of the "inner circle" whose Shōkanjū is described in the light novels. he is revealed to be the leader of the group within Class 2-F known as the FFF Inquisition, which consists exclusively of male Class 2-F students draped in purple-hooded cloaks who discourage any contact between a male student and a female student and pursue draconian punishment on male students. It is thought that perhaps they find it immoral that only they themselves have the curse of loneliness and so inflict it upon all male students. Their favorite victim is Akihisa Yoshii because he is always having romantic events with other girls (usually Mizuki Himeji and Minami Shimada). He sometimes contributes in the Class Wars.  His Shōkanjū wears a martial-arts robe and wields a staff (though in the anime it is not seen).  (source:  )

name: Ryunosuke Ibuki
about: Main character of Hakuoki Reimeiroku.  Although he's obstinate and badmouthing, he also has a gentle side.   After his mother died of illness, he lost his goal and wandered around aimlessly. He was raided by a group of sonnō jōi rōnins heading towards Kyoto, robbed of all his money, and left him to die. When he was about to starve to death, he was saved by Serizawa Kamo. In exchange for saving him, Ryunosuke is forced to become Serizawa's servant. The place he is taken to is the quarters of a group of rōnins who will eventually be known as "Shinsengumi."  Although he was also born in a samurai family, because of what he's been through, Ryu hates "samurai" with a passion. But now he lives with a bunch of youngsters whose lifetime goals are to become samurais. As stubborn as Ryu is, after getting to know them better, and understanding their dreams, his heart begins to change.

name: Zenigame
about: Squirtle is a small reptilian Pokémon that resembles a light-blue turtle. While it typically walks on its two short legs, it has been shown to run on all fours in Super Smash Bros. Brawl. It has large, purplish or reddish eyes and a slightly hooked upper lip. Each of its hands and feet have three pointed digits. The end of its long, squirrel-like tail curls inward. Its body is encased by a tough shell that forms and hardens after birth. This shell is brown on the top, pale yellow on the bottom, and has a thick white ridge between the two halves.  Squirtle's shell is a useful tool. It can withdraw into the shell for protection or to sleep. The grooved, rounded shape helps to reduce water resistance, allowing the Pokémon to swim at high speeds. Squirtle can spray foamy water from its mouth with great accuracy. Squirtle is scarce in the wild, although it can be found around small ponds and lakes. The anime has shown that it can be found living on secluded islands with other members of its evolutionary line. Sharpedo is a natural predator of Squirtle. name: Topaz
about: Topaz is a natural colored Yorkshire Terrier, spotting with a light brown head and hair and a black furry body, ears and tail. The inside of her ears are usually light brown as well. Topaz wears a Jewel Necklace with a purple octagon jewel on it, a purple or pink hair bow and sometimes carries a fan.  Topaz's personality is very lady-like in both the first series and in Kira Deco. Thought in Kira Deco, she is more serious personality wise.  In Jewelpet, she is one of the Jewel Eight. Dian forces her to use her inverted power to take away Kuranosuke's confidence. Rinko's group recovers her through the Jewel Games.  In Jewelpet Twinkle, Topaz is the partner of Hilde, the favourite to win the Jewel Star Grand Prix.  In Jewelpet Kira Deco!, she is the reclusive and skeptical but very talented owner of a clothing shop. In exchange for making clothes for Pink, she sends Ruby off to obtain Flora's wool.  She is in the background in the other seasons.   (Source: Jewelpet Wikia)

name: Rald
about: Rald is a small panda Jewelpet with dark green Jewel Eyes. He wears a dark pink waistcoat and a pink and yellow striped hat. He also has a dark green jewel necklace on his neck.  Rald, in the first two seasons, is as big as the average Jewelpet, but following seasons have made him about double that size, making him the largest Jewelpet yet.  In Jewelpet, he's one of the Jewelpets lost in the human world. After Diana curses Rinko's parents into arguing with each other, Rald appears to them to restore their love and becomes their partner.  In Jewelpet Twinkle, he appears in the New Year's episode. He came to the human world to find his own partner to study magic with. Akari finds him and tries to keep him hidden, but he still causes trouble for her as she helps her school prepare a festival.  In Jewelpet Sunshine, he is a Plum class student. Iruka mistakes him for a delinquent because of his fearsome reputation in the class, but this turns out to be because everyone is just struggling to keep themselves from petting him. He is very popular and sits at the back of the class.  In Jewelpet Kira Deco, he lives in isolation in the outskirts of Jewel Town. He can't speak. He becomes behemoth-sized when he feels lonely; he seriously harmed the KiraDeco 5 because of this. He also temporarily becomes Luna's father.  In Jewelpet Happiness, he forms a Magic Gem with Apel Yamada.  He is in the background in the other seasons.  (Source: Jewelpet Wikia)

name: Yuku
about: Yuku is a naturally colored beagle, usually in Light Brown, Brown and White in color alongside his blue Jewel Eyes. He only wears a Beret on top of his head and a light blue ribbon on his neck.  In the first series, Yuku believes magic shouldn't be relied on for everything, based on his own lack of talent at it.   As the Jewelpet of Intellect, Yuku is one of the more intelligent Jewelpets and has better deductive capacities than any other.   In Jewelpet, he's the Jewelpet partner of the Prime Minister, awoken by him, Rinko and her friends.  In Jewelpet Twinkle☆, he's the partner of Gunho, a contestant at the Jewel Star Grand Prix from the same school as the Three Angels. They fight and lose against Akari and Ruby.  In Jewelpet Sunshine, he's a painter who meets Ruby at a group date and asks her to pretend to marry him to please his grandparents. Ruby gets angry at him for lying to them and he ends up genuinely falling in love with her. He's later seen in the human world trying to sell his art.  In Jewelpet Kira Deco, he's one of the ninjas in the Japanese-styled palace.  In Jewelpet Happiness, he's searching for a girl who helped him many years ago. That girl turns out to be Taira.  In Lady Jewelpet, he's one of the dogs used to test the Petit Ladies' skill at dog-walking. He is partnered with Charon for being the gentlest and most perceptive.   (Source: Jewelpet Wikia)

name: Yoshio Kobayashi
about: Age: 13 Birthday: September 12 Zodiac sign: Virgo Height: 154 cm (5'1") Weight: 45 kg (99 lbs) Blood type: B Famous quote: "I don't think anyone can truly understand another person."  Yoshio Kobayashi, known mostly by his last name is a boy who doesn't have much interest in others and is detached from his surroundings, though he does have a friend, Hashiba. He meets Akechi and gets involved in his investigation.   Kobayashi has short dark hair and a feminine face. He is normally seen in his school uniform. He is often confused for a girl due to his slender appearance, which leads to crossdressing. This particular habit begins in episode 3 due to Watanuki targeting young girls.  In casual clothing, he is normally seen in a baby blue dress with dark blue hemming.  He is naturally inquisitive and does not notice the faces of people who are not significant to him. (They appear to him as gradient-colored silhouettes. The color of these silhouettes varies, depending on the palette of the surroundings.) Kobayashi is bored with his life, due to the lack of excitement. He is framed for the murder of his teacher after awakening in the classroom with the murder weapon in his hands and his teacher's mangled corpse set up in the front of the classroom.

His mocking lack of respect or fear for Megatron intimidated the other Destrons, as well as earning Starscream's hatred.     (Source: Transformers Wiki, edited)

name: Secelia Dote
about: Secelia Dote, is a character in Mobile Suit Gundam the Witch from Mercury. She is a second-year student at Asticassia School of Technology in the management strategy department, who belongs to Burion House.  Secelia is a member of the Dueling Committee who known for making sarcastic and snide remarks to other students. She enjoys getting a rise out of others and flaunting her position on the Committee, and she holds very little respect for others she views as beneath her. She also revels in gossiping and learning about other people's failings and secrets, which she even uses as leverage to blackmail others into doing her bidding.  While she mostly follows gossip for her own amusement, she is observant about the broader mechanics and political stakes surrounding the school and larger conflicts. She is also willing to offer genuine personal advice to others on rare occasions.

about: A first-year student at Sumomogaoka High School. Since middle school, he has been involved in the broadcasting club and has been producing video and radio programs, and has a strong preference for sound production. He is not influenced by others and acts according to his own heart.   (Source: Official Site)

name: Kaika Itsuki
about: He is young 30 year old successful mayoral candidate who pushes for law reform to legalize suicide.

name: Ai Magase
about: Ai Magase is the main antagonist of the series. A manipulator with dissocial personality disorder, her actions are always unpredictable and beyond the understanding of normal people.

name: Amanda
about: Illia's younger sister and leader of the resistance group to stop the oppression by the Emperor towards the people.

name: Illia
about: Illia is Amanda's elder sister. She is in stationed and in charge of the outskirts of the Empire.

name: Tomomi Houryuu
about: A beginner at the rugby club.

name: Tori Fuyuhara
about: The captain of the rugby team.

name: Jin-Woo Sung
about: Age: 24 Occupation: Hunter, Guild Master Rank: E-Rank (beginning) Class: Mage (necromancer) Guild: Ahjin Guild (Guildmaster)  Sung Jin-Woo is the main protagonist of Solo Leveling. Originally an infamously weak E-Rank Hunter, he got the chance of a lifetime when he was selected as the Player of the System, giving him the unique ability to grow in strength without restraint.  Jin-Woo is a confident individual with a strong sense of family and a thirst for power. As a result, he is very close to his mom and sister and rarely wastes an opportunity to grow stronger.  Despite being strong and respected, Jin-Woo isn't arrogant and is both polite and easygoing in person. He is also mostly indifferent to materialistic desires such as fame and fortune and can be very selfless. In battle, however, he is ruthless, slaughtering his enemies indiscriminately and even somewhat disdainful.  Despite going through all hardships and pain, Sung Jin-woo manages to keep his cool in all situations and always try his hardest, becoming a beacon of hope to those who needed him, and despite all this he could still not fathom a well written character arc. But manages to become someone that his family can rely on, and look cool while doing it.   Background:  D-Rank Dungeon Arc:  Reawakening Arc:   (Source: Solo Leveling Wiki, Heroes Wiki, edited)

name: Khara
about: Khara is a Hunter working as a crew member for the Hunter Association's ship and a guide for providing information and rules during the Fourth Phase of the 287th Hunter Exam.  (Source: Hunter x Hunter Wiki)

name: Saku Otonomiya
about: First-year, Class B.  Saku Otonomiya is a genius singer who isn't good at engaging with others. He moved to Tenshou Private Academy for a certain reason. Hinata is his childhood friend who knows about his circumstance. He's usually expressionless but comes alive when he sings.

name: Minare Koda
about: Her day job consists of working at the soup curry restaurant Voyager, but she ends up becoming the host of the Moiwayama Radio Station's (MRS) late-night program Nami yo Kiite Kure. With compliments from  about her natural skill, and her voice able to whip people into an uproar, her ability becomes highly praised.  (Source: ANN)

name: Kanetsugu Matou
about: Chief director of the MRS production team. He recognizes 's natural talent and quickly draws her into the radio industry. He also ends up becoming a "fixer" for 's radio career.  (Source: ANN)

name: Mizuho Nanba
about: Mizuho is the assistant director of MRS. She has been in love with the broadcast industry since her student days.  often says that she laughs out loud for the smallest reasons, but is also very systematic and methodical. She takes care of three turtles at home.  (Source: ANN)

name: Katsumi Kureko
about: Katsumi is MRS' contractual writer. He makes his main business writing erotic novels, but also pens his fair share of mainstream novels. He has a long history in the industry, and is known for his skills in emergency script touch-ups and making up fictional reader-submitted questions and submissions on the spot. He is an old friend of 's.  (Source: ANN)

name: Madoka Chishiro
about: Madoka is a well-known radio host for MRS. She is in charge of the mid-day program Chishiro Madoka no September Blue Moon that centers on lonely hearts, and where  first poured her heart out. She has been worried about  ever since.  (Source: ANN)

name: Ryuusuke Koumoto
about: Ryuusuke is a mixer working for MRS. He has a tendency to be straight-laced and blunt about his work. He has feelings for , but his awkwardness constantly prevents him from confessing his feelings to her.  (Source: ANN)

name: Chuuya Nakahara
about: Chuuya is an employee at the soup curry restaurant Voyager. He is mostly in charge of cooking chicken. He is constantly berated for his hairstyle, but he turns out to have a hidden emotional side. He has feelings for  and is opposed to her entrance into the broadcast industry.  (Source: ANN)

name: Makie Tachibana
about: Makie visits Voyager and introduces herself to Minare and Chuuya as the sister of the man who caused the traffic accident that put the manager into the hospital. Her brother was also injured in the accident, so to make amends on his behalf she volunteers to work at the restaurant without pay. While she gives off an aura of sensitivity, she has a very clear manner of speaking.  (Source: modified from ANN)

name: Yoshiki Takarada
about: Yoshiki is the manager of Voyager. He has managed to maintain a thriving curry restaurant in Sapporo, a city hotly contested by many curry specialists. While he raises his voice quite often at , he is still quite famed for his skill at customer service.  (Source: ANN)

name: Mitsuo Suga
about: Mitsuo is 's ex-boyfriend. He scammed  off ¥500,000 by telling a lie about his "father's company bouncing a check", before promptly disappearing. But his audaciousness is such that, when he hears  over the radio, he tries to contact her again.  (Source: ANN)

name: Prinz Eugen
about: Prinz Eugen is an admiral ship of The Ironblood.  Eugen described as the ship made in the Hipper-class and is she claims to be a highly adaptive ship with countless experiences in combat. Prinz Eugen has also been depicted as also close to Z23, although their exact relationship isn't specifically known.

name: Hibiki Kimiya
about: Kimiya is a shy, weird first year student at Mitoya High who looks up to Kabuto Hanadori. He has really bad luck and carries with him an ax, that is why he is sometimes confused with the death.

name: Utsugi Tsukimiya
about: Utsugi Tsukimiya is a strange high schooler that may or may not be a god.

name: Matatabi
about: Matatabi, more commonly known as the Two-Tails or Nibi, is a tailed beast sealed within Yugito Nii of Kumogakure. It has been captured by Hidan and Kakuzu, then extracted and sealed by Akatsuki.  (Source: Narutopedia)

name: Isobu
about: Isobu, more commonly known as the Three-Tails or Sanbi, is a tailed beast that was formerly sealed in Yagura of Kirigakure.   (Source: Narutopedia)

name: Saiken
about: Saiken, more commonly known as the Six-Tails or Rokubi, is a tailed beast sealed within Utakata of Kirigakure.   (Source: Narutopedia)

name: Son Gokuu
nicknames: Yonbi, Four-Tails, King of the Sage Monkeys
about: Son Gokuu, more commonly known as the Four-Tails or Yonbi, is a tailed beast sealed within Roushi of Iwagakure.   (Source: Narutopedia)

name: Kokuou
about: Kokuou, more commonly known as the Five-Tails or Gobi, is a tailed beast sealed within Han from Iwagakure.   (Source: Narutopedia)

name: Choumei
about: Choumei, more commonly known as the Seven-Tails or Nanabi, is a tailed beast sealed within Fuu from Takigakure.   (Source: Narutopedia)

name: Hagoromo Ootsutsuki
nicknames: Rikudou Sennin, Sage of the Six Paths, God of Shinobi, Saviour of this World
about: The Sage of the Six Paths (六道仙人, Rikudō Sennin) was the legendary figure who founded the arts of ninjutsu and created the ninja world. He defeated the Ten-Tails and sealed it within his own body, thus becoming the first jinchūriki.  (Source: Narutopedia)

name: Ikuko Miyaura
about: Momo's mother.

name: Granduncle
about: Ikuko's uncle.

name: Grandaunt
about: Ikuko's aunt.

name: Kouichi
about: He grew up with Momo's mother when he was little.

name: Umi
about: Youta's little sister.

name: Suzune Ayasaki
about: A mysterious spirit that initially only Hayate seems to see.  For some reason, she seems determined to keep Hayate and Nagi apart by trying to free him from his ¥156,804,000 debt.

name: Queen Bee
about: The  leader of a South American guerrilla group

name: Gendo
about: Gendo is a friend of Sasuke's who is staying at the Kuno's home. Kuno doesn't believe that Gendo is a real fortune teller, so Gendo makes some small predictions to prove it. When Kuno asks who he will marry, Gendo mistakenly forcasts Nabiki, much to Kuno's dismay.  (Source: Rumic World)

name: Yasukichi
about: Yasukichi was a little boy when he moved away from Nerima. He used to have a crush on Kasumi, and is happy to see that she is still living there. When he tries to strike up their old friendship, he realizes she doesn't remember him, and decides to not come between she and Dr. Tofu.  (Source: Rumic World)

name: Akahana
about: Red Nose was a mobile suit pilot and explosives expert belonging to the Principality of Zeon's Marine Corps and Intelligence Strategy department of Kycilia Zabi's Zeon Mobile Assault Force.

name: Asakura
about: Asakura is a Zeon soldier involved with the operation of the Solar Ray. He reports to Gihren on the status of and operability of the Solar Ray system.

name: Barom
about: Barom is a Zeon officer who accompanies M'Quve when he departs Grenada with a fleet to assist at Solomon. Along the way, the fleet comes across an escape capsult containing Zenna and Mineva Zabi. While M'Quve wants to leave them for someone else, Barom convinces him to pick them up, telling M'Quve that soldiers in space are able to fight knowing that someone will be able to rescue them in such a situation if they need it. M'Quve has Barom return with the escape capsult to Granada while he continues onward on another ship. Barom later heads to Texas colony on his own ship but is killed when his ship engages in a battle with Wakkein's Magellan.  (Source: Gundam Wikia)

name: The Black King
about: The Black King first appeared during the first episode of R2 at Babel Tower as a Chess opponent for Lelouch. He also has a reputation as an excellent Chess Player. Whether he earned his reputation because of his skills or by using illicit means is not known.    (Source: Code Geass Wikia)

name: Challia Bull
about: Bull's sole appearance was in episode 39 of Mobile Suit Gundam. He is first shown meeting Admiral Gihren Zabi after he returned from Jupiter. Gihren believes Challia to be a newtype and believes he has strong abilities that can benefit Zeon. Bull was assigned to work under Kycilia Zabi and headed to Granada where he was assigned to operate the Braw Bro. Kycilia speculated that based on his abilities, Challia may have replaced Lalah Sune as pilot of the Elmeth mobile armor. The Braw Bro then headed out and was stationed on Char's Zanzibar where Challia met Char and Lalah. Bull would later pilot the Braw Bro in battle against the Earth Federation's RX-78-2 Gundam and fellow Newtype pilot Amuro Ray. The battle would last a little under 10 minutes before the Braw Bro was destroyed and Bull was killed.  (Source: Gundam Wikia)  In [i]Kidou Senshi Gundam: GQuuuuuuX8[i], Challia Bull forms a two-man Mav team with Char Aznable, and pioneers this style of mobile suit combat. Several years after the Zeknova incident where Char disappeared, he continues to serve in the Zeon military all while searching for the Mav he lost.

name: Clamp
name_kanji: クランプ・テラービン中尉
about: Clamp is Ramba Ral's right hand man, accompanying him during their campaign against the Trojan Horse. Clamp primarily fills a tactician's role, being the one who found the 'Trojan Horse' for them in the first place, and often plotting along with Ral and Hamon about what to do next. When Ramba's squadron eventually completely runs out of supplies, Clamp goes into battle and is shot to death while trying to infiltrate White Base.  (Source: Gundam Wikia)

name: Coaly
about: Coaly was one of the evacuees that was evacuated on board the White Base. When several of the evacuees asked to leave the White Base after they passed the Grand Canyon, he and his mother chose to leave as well. But Persia decided not to travel with the rest of the evacuees, since her town was not far from their current location, however she later discovers that St Anges had been destroyed during the war, unfortunately due to Coaly's youth he is unable to truly fathom his mothers emotional distress upon hearing of the destruction of her home town.  (Source: Gundam Wikia)

name: Conscon
about: Conscon is the commander of a Principality of Zeon mobile task force, consisting of a Chivvay-class heavy cruiser and some Musai-class light cruisers, under the command of Dozle Zabi. Under Dozle's orders, he is dispatched to Side 6 to ambush the White Base so as to humiliate Char and Dozle's sister Kycilia. The arrogant Conscon belittles Char, but is quickly humbled when White Base destroys 12 Rick Doms during a battle just outside of Side 6. When White Base later leaves Side 6 for good, Conscon launches another attack. When his mobile suits are quickly defeated, he tries to ram his Chivvay into White Base in a kamikaze attack, but Amuro manages to destroy it with Gundam's beam sabers, killing him.  (Source: Gundam Wikia)

name: Cozun Graham
about: Cozun is a veteran squadron in Ramba Ral's squadron and one of Ral's wingmen along with Acous. He pilots a MS-06J Zaku II Ground Type and usually accompanies Ramba Ral in battle. Although he does well in his first battle against White Base, Cozun is cornered by the Guncannon (piloted by Amuro) while retreating from a later battle, and is taken prisoner. He easily breaks out using an exploding tooth, and manages to send classified information on White Base to Ramba Ral. While attempting to escape, Cozun is killed when Omur foolishly uses a bazooka to open a door between them.

name: Madoka Aoyagi
about: "I want to be the main heroine, too!"  The manager of the FC club, classmate of Masaya and company, and the little sister of Shion. Very lively and responsible, she doesn't shine as bright as the others, but she never give up of her ideal to one day will be her time to it!

name: Crown
about: A mobile suit pilot for Zeon, he and Char Aznable attacked the federation ship White Base in his Zaku II when it was attempting to enter the earth's atmosphere. His battle with the RX-78-2 Gundam lasted too long and was pulled in by earth's gravity and incinerated along with his Zaku by the frictional heat from entering the atmosphere.

name: Cuaran
about: Cuaran is one of a number of Zeon soldiers stationed at a remote base. When the White Base nears the base, Cuaran comes up with a plan to destroy the Gundam by placing bombs on it. Taking part in his plan are several other Zeon soldiers including Giyal and Sol. Cuaran's team is successful in attaching a half dozen bombs on the Gundam, but watch as Amuro is able to remove all of them. They drive by in civilian clothes afterwards and wish him and the other White Base crew good luck.

name: Cucuruz Doan
about: Not much is known of Doan's past. It is known that he was a pilot for the Principality of Zeon, piloting a MS-06 Zaku. However, during a battle, his gun had misfired and killed civilians. He was ordered to kill children, who were the children of the civilians he had accidently killed, but he could not do it. He deserted the army, took the children and took up residence on an island in the Pacific, swearing an oath to himself to protect them. Soon after, Amuro Ray would end up discovering the deserting Zeon solider. Doan and Amuro would have a short scuffle, and Doan would hide Amuro's Core Fighter. At first, Amuro viewed him as an enemy who had brainwashed the children. When a Zaku had discovered the island, Amuro was given his Core Fighter back and fought alongside Doan. As Doan explains his relation with the children, Amuro sympathizes him.  Doan had sworn never to use guns again and instead use what he called "Mobile Suit Martial Arts".  After using the Gundam to launch Doan's Zaku into the ocean, Amuro would later be picked up by White Base, leaving Doan in peace.

name: Darota
about: Lt. Darota is an officer who works under Garma. After Garma's death, Icelina comes to Garma's former headquarters and meets up with Darota so they can launch an attack of revenge on White Base. They do so, with Darota in charge of the main Gaw in charge of the attack. When Gundam attacks the Gaws, he is seriously wounded and dies when Icelina takes over for him and crashes the Gaw into the Gundam. Darota was loyal both to Garma and his lover, but unfortunately ends up losing his life because of it. The events of his teaming up Icelina and his death do not occur in the Mobile Suit Gundam compilation movies, though it was likely he died off-screen at some point.

name: Shion Aoyagi
about: "Muscles Uooooooh!!!"  President of the FC club and unique member of the club, that's why he wants Masaya and his friends in. Very kind and very passionate, and that passion for him it's called: "Muscles"!

name: Denim
about: Under Char Aznable, Denim was placed in charge of a recon mission to Side 7 with Slender and Gene to spy on an Earth Federation base that was transporting a new type of mobile suit. When Gene decided to disobey orders and start attacking the base, Denim had no choice but to back him up. When Amuro Ray gets into the cockpit of the RX-78-2 Gundam and critically damages Gene's Zaku, Denim orders Gene to retreat with Slender, until Amuro cleaves and destroys the retreating Zaku. Denim, enraged by the rookie's death, makes one final rush at the Gundam. Amuro, desperate not to explode the incoming Zaku's engine and fatally damage Side 7, runs the Gundam's Beam Saber through the cockpit of the Zaku, stopping it dead in its tracks and instantly incinerating Denim inside.

name: Dimitri
about: Dimitri was the pilot of the MA-04X Zakrello mobile armor. During the White Base's ascent to space, he witnessed his fellow mobile armor pilot Tokwan die at the hands of Amuro Ray in the RX-78-2 Gundam. Dimitri requests to head out to battle following Tokwan's defeat, but is told by Char to wait, as they will have other chances later. Dimitri instead gets permission from Char's subordinate Mulligan to head out in the Zakrello. He is quickly defeated and killed by Amuro, piloting the Gundam Sky.

name: Dren
about: Dren was Char Aznable's second-in-command when he first led the attack on Side 7. He remained with Char for the duration of their chasing the White Base to Earth. Afterward, he continued to serve under Char until the death of Garma Zabi, when Char was sent to be stationed with Zeon's forces Belfast. He returned to space and led the Camel Squadron. When the White Bass returned to space to aid in the upcoming fighting, Char countered them by acquiring the assistance of Dren's patrol squadron. During the battle, the RX-78 Gundam struck Dren's Musai with the beam saber, creating a massive opening, causing Dren to be sent to his death by being sucked into space.

name: Elran
about: Elran is an Earth Federation General stationed aboard General Revil's Big Tray. Elran is secretly colluding with Captain M'Quve of the Zeons, and receives order from him via a soldier named Judoch. As Operation Odessa approaches, M'Quve orders him to restrain the Federation's forces on certain fronts. When Amuro and Sayla spot Judoch's plane leaving from Zeon controlled territory, they follow it to the Big Tray and Amuro presents Elran proof that Judoch is a spy. Elran pulls a gun on Amuro, planning to kill him, but the conversation had been monitored and Elran is arrested.

name: Flanagan
about: Dr. Flanagan was a doctor from Zeon's Flanagan Institute, which specialized in Newtypes. He assists in the development and research of the mobile armor Elmeth, as well as its pilot Lalah Sune.   This character had a different appearance in the original TV series. The main character designer Yoshikazu Yasuhiko redesigned him for the movie trilogy and that version has been used ever since.  In the light novel adaptation of the original series, his full name is Lom Flanagan.

name: Félix Louis-Claude Mont d'or
name_kanji: フェリクス・ ルイ＝クロード・モンドール

name: Empress Dowager
about: Note: Empress Dowager is not her name but it is her title. It means the mother or widow of an emperor, especially in the Chinese, Japanese, or Korean Empire.

name: Herman Kokko
about: He is the president of Kokko Trading Company and owns a company near the port of Helsinki. After reading the letter Katri brought, he let Vilkki recall the customer who had just left the office.

name: Takane D. Goodman
about: Takane D. Goodman is a high-school student and secret mage. Her magical affinity is shadows, and she can summon and direct shadow warriors, as well as create highly elaborate shadow armor, which mimics clothes. When she is defeated and her magic depleted this causes her armor-clothes to disappear, leaving her naked. This tends to cause her trauma within the story, as it generally happens in front of a group of people. It looks like she has a crush on Negi after defeated by him in mahora martial arts tournament based on her behavior around him. This was confirmed at the end of the manga when she challenged him to a fight and demanded that he must go out with her if she wins. After she loses against Negi without being stripped she asks him why he didn't strip her and asks if it was out of pity or it was because she no longer attractive to him and chases him yelling at him if he was going to undress her or go out with her before their "marriage". In the final chapter she and Mei are seen working with Akashi Yuna as agents of Megalo-Mesembria.  (Source: Wikipedia)  No voice actors have been added to this character. Help improve our database by searching for a voice actor, and adding this character to their roles .

name: Barolt
about: He is one of the four heroes blessed by the Goddesses. He is a Valtarian warrior and is considered the strongest among the four heroes. He has a current level of 200, though the other's are unknown. Hanbin Ryu and his group locate him to get his help to free Kivye and stop Garhan and Zenovia. He knows Hanbin is an other worlder, but he doesn't care as Eric fights for what is right. He helps to train Hanbin and Andrian so they will be able to defeat the other heroes.  (Source: Survival Story of a Sword King in a Fantasy World)  No voice actors have been added to this character. Help improve our database by searching for a voice actor, and adding this character to their roles .

name: Wilhelm Josef Von Herrman
name_kanji: ヴィルヘルム・ヨーゼフ・フォン・へルマン
about: Graf Wilhelm Josef Von Herrman is a high level demon, who poses as a descendant of a line of German counts. He is one of the many demons who attacked Negi's village and the one who turned nearly everyone in the village to stone. He is sealed during the attack and released to gauge the threat that Negi and Asuna represent, and to temporarily disable Negi from combat. He is defeated by Negi and Kotaro, though Negi spares his life. He is connected to Fate Averruncus and his group.  In his human form, he looks like an elderly gentleman wearing a suit and a hat. He is a very strong physical fighter, with a fighting style that seems rooted in boxing, who can use magic without chanting. However, his greatest weapon is his petrification spell. He permanently petrified the citizens of Negi's childhood home. This petrification is seemingly incurable; however, it is revealed in the final volume that Konoka is capable of developing her powers sufficiently enough to restore the citizens.  (Source: Wikipedia)  No voice actors have been added to this character. Help improve our database by searching for a voice actor, and adding this character to their roles .

about: Eric (or Aeric) is the main protagonist of the story. His real name is Ryu Han-Bin, which he had changed to Eric to conceal his identity as an Otherworlder (humans that originate from Earth.) name: Wiene
about: Wiene is a mysterious female Vouivre born in the middle floors of the Dungeon.

name: Lissos
about: Lissos is a member of the Apollo Familia.

name: Luan Espel
about: Luan Espel is a member of the Apollo Familia.

name: Ares
about: Ares is the head of the kingdom style Familia Rakia and his own Familia, the Ares Familia.

name: Marius Victrix Rakia
name_kanji: マリウス・ウィクトリクス・ラキア
about: Marius Victrix Rakia is the crown prince of Rakia and the vice-captain of the Ares Familia.

name: Temari Kaminarimon
about: This little girl practices Shitamachi Martial Arts, or "Good Old Days Martial Arts". She manages to defeat Akane in battle, and win the Tendo Dojo sign, but is later defeated when Akane sees through her attack.  (Source: Rumic World)

name: Kumajiro Kaminarimon
about: Temari's grandfather

name: Yutaro Yudono
about: The Tendos, Saotomes and Ryoga travel to a hot spring, which they later find out is haunted. It is revealed that Yutaro, the hot spring owners son, has been attacking people rather than a ghost. Yutaro is looking for a bride, and after Akane suggests that this pretty boy should to a TV commerical, customers flock to his run-down hotspring. Unfortunately for Akane, Yutaro now thinks he's too important to talk to her.  (Source: Rumic World)

name: Frog Hermit
about: The Frog Hermit is an unnamed anime-only character who makes a living by doing shows with his trained frogs and earning money by doing so. He has a strong rivalry against Ranma Saotome who knocks him into the cursed spring of drowned frog (Chiwanīchuan) while Ranma was training with his father Genma at Jusenkyo.

name: Gambling King
name_kanji: キンニー・博打王キング
about: Casino King is the name that the Gambling King gives to any area where he can set up his rigged gambling games, which include dice games, card games against the King himself, and pachinko machines. It is typically little more than a small stall at a fair or festival, or some relatively sheltered spot in an out of the way position on the street, but when the King successfully "wins" the Tendo Dojo from Ranma in a rigged game, he converts it into a much larger version, taking advantage of its wide space and sturdy roof.

name: Keiko Tanaka
about: A spoiled brat and Megumi's rival. She shows up later in the series. She suffers a form of superiority complex. She hates Megumi because she realizes that everyone around her thinks Megumi is more beautiful than she is. Now she follows Megumi where ever she goes in hope of dis-proving Megumi's beauty.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Tsubasa Amatsuka
about: Megumi's mother. Her work requires her to travel around the world, so she's rarely home.

name: Megumi's Father
about: His real name is unknown. Megu-papa is perverted like Yasuda, frequently seen entering Megumi's room through secret entrances he creates without Megumi's permission.

name: Yoshimi Shirasagi
about: Keiko's friend. In later episodes, she fell in love with Genzō because he saved her right in time. Somehow, the feelings changed when she was saved by Fujiki when she falls in a stair during their field trip in Kyoto and calls Fujiki her "prince".  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Yoriko
about: Amatsuka's housemaid. She was first seen on episode 11 of the anime. She was always seen in the anime as Megumi's investigator and a substitute to Tsubasa in times of need. She even helped Megu by revising the rules of Yamato Nadeshiko cup in order to that the rules will be fair and square.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Yamato Majima
about: Main protagonist of BL Game ESCAPE  No voice actors have been added to this character. Help improve our database by searching for a voice actor, and adding this character to their roles .

name: Maiko Fujishima

name: Kaze'Aaze
about: Kaze'aze, sometimes known as KazeAaze, KazeAze, or Kaze'Aze, Jin Kaze'aze, and entitled the Queen of Darkness, is the major antagonist behind the scenes.   She can be found in her castle as the boss after defeating a possessed Lass. She is the main cause of the war between the kingdoms of Serdin and Kanavan. She first killed the Queen of Kanavan's most trusted advisor and then disguised herself as him, and then possessed the Kanavan Queen. She then waged a 5 year war with Serdin. After the war ended, the Kanavan Queen was eventually freed due to the Serdin Queen's sacrifice. However, Kaze'aze escaped after she was found out but before she could be executed. Thus, the Queen of Kanavan banded together an alliance of Kanavan Trackers, made to protect the Kanavan Kingdom from further suffering by Kaze'aze. Unfortunately, none of the Trackers ever returned, so the Queen of Serdin made a group called Grand Chase to find and defeat her, for the sake of all Bermesiah. name: Victor
about: Victor, also known as Luthor, is the boss of Victor's Fortress. Victor is the ex-leader of the Silver Knights, and the leader of the Black Knights. He served under Ascendant God and betrayed the Silver Knights for his own greed of power. Thanatos was actually using him for his own purposes. Victor, in his second form, also appears throughout Silver Land's Boss Gates.  According to the description of Rama and his Monster Card, Victor was said to be "fleeing" from the Chase, and trying to use the Vajras to become one with Rama. However, the true Rama himself came along and punished Victor with death. However, none of these are actually true from seen in-game. There was nothing about him trying to retreat, train, or even killed by Rama; it was Fighter instead. However, because Jin has Rama as his job it could be speculated that the true Rama killed Victor but not as the job.  King Fang informs Jin that the messenger who appealed to him had an aura similar to those of a Silver Knight, but the aura was like a dark fog rather than clear, bright energy. Jin concludes Victor betrayed Silver Land. Victor is seen at his own castle, and he taunts Jin claiming he used and killed the Silver Knights as they were weak and Silver Land can only be protected with darkness. Jin vows revenge. After defeating his first form (drops to 10% HP), he regains full health, and goes under a transformation (the Grand Chase call it "Revival"). After defeating his second, he seems to "revive" again. The battle almost seems endless and tiring, but Jin requests that the Chase believe in him. They do so, as Jin (Fighter) enters Burning Rage, and executes Burning Fist of 10,000 Hells, which kills Victor upon impact. Upon Victor's defeat, he asks the Lord of Darkness for more strength, but one of his "Voices" tell him that Victor was just his pawn, and leaves him to die. At the castle, Lire says that Gaikoz lost a lover when a war (it was not stated which one, though it was most likely the one between Serdin and Kanavan) broke out, and he died from a trap. Arme is pitiful towards the fallen knight, and Elesis states that the tragedy made him a monster. Gaikoz himself admits he works for Kaze'aze, who is seemingly building a "bright future" supposedly full of pain and death. Ronan shortly joins the battle, and the ghost knight is slain. name: Flanagan Boone
about: Boone is a Zeon captain stationed near the Federation's Belfast, Ireland base. When White Base arrives at the base, Boone takes the opportunity to launch multiple attacks on White Base. During the second such attack, he has a spy, Miharu Ratokie head on board the White Base such that she can provide him with information on where it is headed. Boone follows the White Base across the Atlantic Ocean and successfully infiltrates it using a stolen civilian plane such that he can communicate with Miharu, who tells him that White Base is headed to South America. Boone reports this information to Char then gets permission to pilot the MAM-07 Grublo mobile armor such that he can avenge the death of his men that had fallen to White Base and the Gundam. Boone successfully launches an attack on White Base and does battle with the Gundam underwater. While the Grublo has the advantage at first and manages to grab the Gundam's leg with one of its claws, the Gundam however is able to escape its grasps and then attacks the Grublo's cockpit with one of its beam sabers, killing Boone.

name: Gadem
about: During the One Year War, Gadem is sent by Dozle Zabi to resupply Char Aznable's Musai after a failed reconnaissance mission at Side 7. Their ships rendezvoused at Luna II.  Unfortunately, they were detected by the crew of the White Base. White Base sent out Amuro Ray in the RX-78-2 Gundam and Ryu Jose in the FF-X7 Core Fighter to destroy the ship. The two went around the ships so that the sun was behind them, rendering the Gundam and the Core Fighter invisible.  While the Musai and Char fended off the attacks, Gadem attempted to unload as many supplies as possible before his ship was destroyed. He managed to escape however, in his MS-05 Zaku I. Gadem tried to destroy the Gundam without weapons to avenge his honor despite the warnings of Char, but the Gundam manages to destroy his Zaku I.

After realizing how powerful the Gundam was Gene tried to flee, but his Zaku was cut in half by Amuro's Beam Saber, causing the Zaku to explode with Gene still inside.

name: Giyal
about: Giyal is a Zeon mobile suit pilot stationed at a remote base which White Base passes. Giyal participates in an operation led by Cuaran to destroy the Gundam by placing a number of bombs on it. Giyal's part in the plan is to lure the Gundam out using his Zaku, which he does by attacking Lt. Matilda's Medea transport ship when it heads out.

name: Gopp
about: Gopp is an Earth Federation Admiral stationed at Jaburo. Before the One Year War he oversaw the construction of Jaburo and discussed Zeon's mobile worker construction with Tem Ray. When White Base arrives at Jaburo, Bright and Mirai meet before Gopp multiple times, and are eventually ordered by him to head to space along with the Tianem fleet. Gopp expresses sorrow over the death of Mirai's father and states that the war may have been avoided had he not died.  (Source: Gundam Wikia)

name: Jill Ratokie

When she decides to sneak aboard White Base, Miharu provides Jill and Milly with money so they can eat, and says goodbye to them.  (Source: Gundam Wikia)

name: Judock
about: Judock acted as a spy for Captain M'Quve in the Federation forces. He acted as a liaison between M'Quve and Federation General Elran in the lead up to Operation Odessa. Shortly before the battle of Odessa, Amuro Ray and Sayla Mass witnessed Judock departing in a Federation plane from Zeon controlled territory. They follow him to the Big Tray and Judock is arrested by other Federation soldiers. His ultimate fate is unknown.  (Source: Gundam Wikia)

name: Mosk Han
about: Following the battle with Challia Bull, Amuro finds that the Gundam can no longer respond to his quick reflexes without overheating. White Base heads to Solomon, where Mosk Han arrives and proposes applying a magnetic coating to the Gundam to solve the problem. This successfully allows the Gundam to operate effectively again. Mosk tells Amuro he can thank him by providing him with the data following his next battle.

name: Omur Fang
about: Omur Fang was originally a cadet in training much like Ryu Jose. He became an operator on board the White Base. He also was White Base's resident bomb expert and frequently helped out in the dock with the preparation of mobile suits. He was responsible for the death of captured Zeon soldier Cozun Graham when he attempted to open a door with a bazooka. Although he played a minor role, he had a fair amount of appearances by the virtue of the fact that he was an operator and thus a member of the crew giving frequent reports. Despite this fact a surprisingly large number of individuals played the role in the Japanese dub.

Sol takes part in Cuaran's team, who are successful in attaching a half dozen bombs on the Gundam, but watch as Amuro is able to remove all of them. They drive by in civilian clothes afterwards and wish him and the other White Base crew good luck.

name: Tachi O'Hara
about: Tachi was a Zeon officer that assisted Crowley Hamon in her plans to attack White Base and avenge Ramba Ral's death. During their attack. Tachi piloted the squad's last remaining Zaku while Hamon led a series of Magella Tops located on top of a Gallop hovercraft. During the battle Tachi manages to jump aboard White Base and attack it with his Zaku, but Hamon calls him back to attack the Gundam when he attempts to stop the explosive-laden Gallop from hitting White Base. Tachi attacks the Gundam in his Zaku, but Amuro manages to flip it above him, directly into the blast of one of the Zeon's Magella Tops, resulting in Tachi's death.

name: Tamura
about: Tamura is the chef aboard White Base. He first appears in episode 9, when Kai questions him for providing larger meals to Amuro and Ryu. He later returns in episode 16, expressing concern over the ship's lack of salt. This results in White Base changing course to find salt water to replenish their supply. His final appearance is in episode 33 when he goes along with Amuro and Fraw to a shopping center in Side 6 to buy groceries.

name: Tokwan
about: In the Mobile Suit Gundam series, Tokwan was a subordinate of Char Aznable and the pilot of the MA-05 Bigro on board a Zanzibar-class cruiser. Char comes across Tokwan's Zanzibar just as White Base is heading to outer space, and uses it to follow them. Piloting the MA-05 Bigro, Tokwan engaged in combat with Amuro Ray in the RX-78-2 Gundam, but was quickly dispatched when a shot from the Gundam's beam rifle pierced the Bigro's cockpit. Another pilot, Dimitri, launched in the MA-04X Zakrello to avenge Tokwan, only to suffer the same fate.

name: Twanning
about: Twanning is a Zeon officer stationed in the control room of A Baoa Qu. When Kycilia Zabi assassinates Gihren Zabi, Twanning quickly calms down the other soldiers and gets them following Kycilia's orders. Kycilia later gives him orders to surrender A Baoa Qu, telling him that she'll arrange to get him back when they exchange POWs.

name: Uragang

Like many characters, Uragang gets a noticeable amount of screen time, but has little of a role in the plot of the show itself. Uragang meets his end at the Texas colony along with the rest of M'Quve's troops.

name: Mushiki Kuga
about: Mushiki Kuga is the main protagonist of King's Proposal. He is a ordinary high schooler who has inherited the body and identity of Saika Kuozaki and is assuming them to retain order at Void Garden.  Mushiki, in his original form, appears as an average height young androgynous looking boy in his teens with messy white hair and sky blue eyes. After becoming a student of Void's garden himself, he is given the male student uniform.   Mushiki has a personality of a typical teenager: getting flustered by unknown situation and girls, and becoming serious whenever needed to. He is also extremely soft-spoken and spoke in a very polite way of speaking. He notably shows a very strong admiration for Saika Kuozaki, describing himself to fall in love with her at first sight and described her in a flamboyant and excited manner whenever she is mentioned, much to Kuroe Karasuma's apparent disgust. While at first Mushiki can be seen as quite simple-minded he actually not as dumb as we've seen earlier because he managed to deduce that Kuroe is actually Saika in disguise by himself at the end of Volume 1. Before they parted ways because of currently unknown circumstances, it is stated that Mushiki is a good older brother for his younger sister Ruri, which is proven by her having a very fond memory of him. name: Mr. Gentleman
about: Claimed to be the true source of power behind the United Kingdom, Mr. Gentleman is revered by the British Library as the key to regaining the UK's dominance over the world. In the OVA, Gentleman appears to be the head of the British Library's Special Operations Division. His physical abilities are limited, but his intellect and knowledge are superior to the average man's. He is Joseph Carpenter's commander, and authorizes the missions.  In the novels, he is the first human male (His counter part is China, who organized Dokusensha), and already lived for over 500,000 years. His old man form is for preserving his life energy, if he stayed in this form, he can maybe live for around 100 years or so more. However, he is not satisfied with this, and wanted to live longer, and one of his plans is to capture Faust, who seems to be one of his more direct decedents that has a much longer life span(about 800 years old and still liking like a child). The research on Faust is not very fruitful, and he switched to finding the Gutenburg Book, obtaining a single page called the Gutenburg paper in the process and to decipher it, he released Faust to do the interpretation, which Faust took the opportunity to escape to Dokusensha, taking Yomiko with him. Gentleman is dissatisfied with his agents working too SLOWand know that the only person that can face the mastermind of Dokusensha, China, is he himself, and he switched to his young form, Young man, which he estimated to only be able to sustain for around a week, and forced his way into Dokusensha's HQ.  (Source: R.O.D Wikia)

about: Misdreavus is a dark bluish-green, ghost-like Pokémon. While it has no visible arms or legs, its lower half has several small appendages and resembles a ruffled dress. It has five round red gems halfway around its neck, which are used to absorb fear and use it as nourishment. When defeated in the side series games, its body disappears, leaving only the gems around its neck behind. This implies that Misdreavus retreats into the gems when it has been severely weakened. It has long, flowing lilac-tipped "hair". Misdreavus's large, red eyes have yellow sclerae.  Misdreavus lives in caves. As a nocturnal Pokémon, it spends its days sleeping in darkness and its nights startling people with mischievous tricks. Since it loves watching frightened people, it is known to yank and bite at people's hair or sneak up on them and cry and shriek in a way a child would. In the animated series, Misdreavus is shown to be able to use its "hair" to grasp objects and other Pokémon, as if it were hands. Flutter Mane shares a resemblance to Misdreavus. It was theorized to be a giant Misdreavus reborn as a pterosaur ghost.  Evolution Misdreavus evolves into Mismagius.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

nicknames: Welsh Dragon, Red Dragon Emperor, Red-One, Breast Dragon Emperor
about: Race: Dragon (Heavenly Dragon) First Appearance: Volume 2  Ddraig is one of the Two Heavenly Dragons, the Red Dragon known as the Welsh Dragon and Red Dragon Emperor who resides within the Boosted Gear, wielded by Issei Hyoudou. He is feared among the Angels, Fallen Angels, and Devils for his destructive powers, which are said to be able to kill both Gods and Satans.  In the past, Ddraig fought against his arch-rival, the Vanishing Dragon, Albion, which was interrupted by the Angels, Devils, and Fallen Angels who are at war during the time. In anger, both Dragons attacked the leaders of the Three Factions, which led to their bodies being destroyed and their souls being sealed into two separate Sacred Gears, with Ddraig being placed inside the Sacred Gear "Boosted Gear".  At one point before he was sealed into the Boosted Gear, Ddraig rampaged in the Realm of the Dead along with Albion. He also fought against Grendel sometime in the past.  Ddraig appears in the beginning of Volume 2, introducing himself to Issei. He reappears after Issei’s defeat at the hand of Riser Phenex, telling him about the "White Guy".  In Volume 3, Ddraig has a conversation with Issei as the two eventually start a teacher-student relationship, with Ddraig giving advice to Issei during fights such as the fight against Kokabiel and the crisis with the Khaos Brigade in Volume 4. Ddraig also teaches Issei about many things regarding the mythological world.         Being sealed within Boosted Gear, Ddraig has yet to show his true personal power and full array of abilities. It is known that he can multiply and transfer power, and has the common powers of Dragons, but it is unknown if this is the full extent of his abilities.  When his powers are unsealed, Ddraig is stated to have power enough to rival or kill a God or a Satan.  (Source: Highschool DxD Wikia)

name: Seizou Harugasaki
about: Seizo Harugasaki (春ヶ崎 歲晴, Harugasaki Seizou) is a former member of the Gotei 13's 11th Division.  Personality: Seizo is a very kind and helpful man. He always does what he is told and has no problems with doing the 11th Division's more menial tasks. He always offers help or assistance, giving Ichigo Kurosaki some ointment for his bruised forehead and later offering Ichigo advice on how to beat Renji in a sparring match. Ichigo noted that he is very mild-mannered, unlike the rest of his Division. Through years of work, he has become extremely efficient in doing the chores of the 11th Division, beating Ichigo in a race of washing clothes, hanging laundry and other tasks, with ease. He is an extremely noble fighter, never wanting to use any kind of trick to gain the upper hand. When he used to fight Ikkaku Madarame, he never resorted to any ploy even after losing constantly. He does not back down, no matter how impossible the challenge is. He places the safety of other above his own, pushing Ikkaku out of the way of a Hollow and taking the attack himself.  History: Seizo joined the 11th Division around the same time as Ikkaku. He was a promising Shinigami whose sword skills were a sight to behold. He often sparred with Ikkaku but lost repeatedly due to not wanting to use any kind of trick. Even though he kept losing, he would not give up.  One night, Ikkaku and Seizo were a part of a team tracking down a Hollow. Seizo volunteered to go on ahead but Ikkaku protested, saying that he had lost their matches too many times. Seizo refuted this, saying that they were simply draws but hesitated for a moment once the Hollow appears. Ikkaku ran up ahead and struck the Hollow. When the Hollow went to attack Ikkaku, Seizo pushed him out of the way and took the attack himself, leaving him drained of his spiritual power.  (Source: Bleach Wikia)

about: Age: Currently Unknown Height: Currently Unknown Eye Color: Light Yellow Hair Color: Black Occupation: Witch Affiliation: Mantinel Witches' Association Majik(s) Acquired: Currently Unknown  Desscaras, known as the Abyssal Witch, is a powerful magic user in this world where Majik, a living force, grants power through difficult trials. She is confident and skilled, often taking charge of dangerous missions like confronting King Uroro, a destructive Majik. Despite her serious nature, Desscaras sometimes dismisses caution, preferring to handle matters on her own.  Desscaras is a stunning and captivating figure with a dark complexion. Her exceptionally long, thick, curly black hair is styled into voluminous pigtails, with intricate bubble braids and several curly tufts on both sides. Her pale yellow eyes, which really stands out, and her delicate face are further softened by her neatly cropped micro bangs. Known as the most beautiful witch of them all, her delicate frame accentuates her ethereal and mesmerizing appearance. She frequently dons a tall, black top hat, which lends a touch of sophistication and elegance. A long, flowing black piece that hangs from the hat's rear down like a cape enhances the aura and mystique of her image.  Desscaras is confident and assertive, often preferring to take matters into her own hands without waiting for others. She can be dismissive of help, believing it would only slow her down, and is focused on her goals with a no-nonsense attitude. She is determined, focused, and unafraid to confront powerful foes like King Uroro, showcasing her belief in her abilities.  Despite her tough exterior, she has a practical approach to situations, valuing efficiency over unnecessary assistance, which leads others, like Monegold, to view her as a handful. Even when faced with dangerous situations, she remains composed and determined, unafraid to challenge powerful enemies like King Uroro. However, she also shows a degree of impatience, especially when things don't go as planned.  (Source: Ichi The Witch Wiki)  No voice actors have been added to this character. name: Ichi
about: Age: Currently Unknown, presumably a teenager Height: 165 cm (5'5") Weight: 60kg (132 lbs) Eye Color: Red, Blue Hair Color: Black Occupation: Witch Former Occupation: Hunter Affiliation: Mantinel Witches' Association Majik(s) Acquired:   Ichi is the first known male witch and the contractor of the legendary Majik King Uroro.   Ichi’s usual outfit is perfect for life on the mountain. He wears a heavy coat to stay warm, sturdy boots for rough terrain, and practical gloves. His outfit also includes a fluffy cape or feathered collar for extra protection from the weather. His black hair is usually messy but is sometimes tied back to keep it out of his face. Overall, his clothing is practical and suited to the tough mountain environment.  Ichi's isolated childhood in the mountains has given him the courage and boldness of a young man with strong hunting and survival instincts. He was abandoned at the age of six and forced to live alone, where he struggled to make ends meet and was nearly suicidal. But after all of this, he demonstrated inner fortitude when facing a wolf, and he came out of it determined to live and improve his abilities. He gains an appreciation for life, improves his hunting and gathering skills, and becomes resolute in his desire to survive.  Despite spending years alone, Ichi never had any difficulties interacting with others. As can be observed, upon his return to the hamlet after killing a moose, he was greeted with great warmth by the locals. In kind, he replies in a lighthearted, pleasant, and personable manner. In addition, he would comfortably converse with the women of the village about their plans and offer to share rabbit meat with them while they travel, even if he claims he is unable to go since he still has personal work to complete. Although Ichi seemed to like living in the mountains, and while he was grateful for the villagers' hospitality, his attention was on himself.  Ichi's life experience made him a thoughtful and realistic individual. Since he values life, he believes that killing without cause is murder. The only species that should be killed in his opinion are those who pose a threat to humanity's existence. His instincts and situational awareness come through when he chooses not to use any of his hunting weapons until it is absolutely essential when he faces the creature.  In addition, Ichi has a strong sense of justice and acts quickly when he perceives danger. Ichi uses his keen senses and strategically placed traps to outwit King Uroro and ultimately prevail in their battle. Ichi is determined, charging confidently into danger and acting decisively when the need arises. Ichi can adapt even when he is confused, as he is when he first gains magical abilities.  He is also eager about the prospect of hunting Majiks despite his lack of understanding of the magical realm, as it makes sense given his background as a hunter. Despite not knowing all the answers, he accepts Desscaras' plan because he loves thrills and adventures. Ichi is ultimately propelled forward by his boldness, independence, and curiosity; he is fearless in the face of uncertainty and motivated to find solutions to issues on his own.  (Source: Ichi The Witch Wiki)  No voice actors have been added to this character. Help improve our database by searching for a voice actor, and adding this character to their roles .

name: Jerry
about: Jerry, or "Mr. Policeman" as Sora and some of her friends call him, is a character that appears since Kaleido Star's first episode. He also is one of the only characters of a different race among everyone else. He works for the Cape Mary police station and personally gave Sora a ride to Kaleido Stage from the station when they mistake her for a runaway child. Jerry likes to call himself "Sora's number one fan" since he is a big fan of Kaleido Stage as well after Sora tells Jerry her dream. When with Ken during their trip to Japan to see Sora after leaving, he calls Ken "Sora's number two fan" out loud, much to Ken's displeasure. In a later episode in the second season, Jerry reveals that he was once picked on as a child which caused him to bulk himself up over the years. Jerry is always there for Sora's shows and is always seen in the audience somewhere. During New Wings, he needs Sora and Ken's help when he wants to propose to Kate before his 30th birthday is up (which was the same day as the episode), but can't find her and is extremely nervous. When he finally catches up to her, a robbery takes place in the bank and he is left tied up while Sora tries to perform for the criminal. After Sora succeeds in making him smile and willingly surrender himself to the police, he tells Kate that he would like "to place her in eternal arrest" (his way of proposing to her while riddled with embarassment). Kate said she would love to and Jerry is overfilled with joy.  (Source: Kaleido Star Wikia)

name: Kate
about: Kate is a less seen character of Kaleido Star and is a medical doctor for the performers at Kaleido Stage. She is a long time friend of Jerry since they were kids. She first appears when Sora's father was brought to the hospital and again when Sora went to Marine Park to train for Arabian Nights. She also helped Layla when she injured her shoulder while training for the Legendary Great Maneuver. Kate is a very kind and generous person but is quite serious about her work and can be strict about making sure her patients do what she tells them to. She is always with Jerry when going to see Sora's shows. In New Wings, she is apart of a bank robbery and is held hostage along with Jerry. After the robbery was over, Jerry lets Kate know about how he felt about her and accepted Jerry's proposal.  (Source: Kaleido Star Wikia)

about: She is a third-year high school student of Central High School and a member of its student council. Her real name is unknown and she is always referred to as Senpai by her underclassman Yanagi and her friends. She occasionally hangs out with the trio and teaches them how to become a cute high school girl.  She is on bad terms with Habara's Senpai and is shown to always be the first one to resort to force. It is later revealed that they were classmates during their third year of grade school with Ikushima's Senpai. It is also hinted that she had something to do with the scar on Karasawa's right arm.

name: Jean Benigni
about: Jean is the father of Marion Benigni and is a set designer. He helps to bring the stage to life for each of Kaleido Stage's shows by creating some of the stages where the performers perform their shows on. Jean was the one who told Sora of Marion's past when she is acting mean towards her and Sora's friends. Jean isn't really seen much but is always there for Sora and her friends when she needs it. He comments that when Sora puts her mind to something, it always finds a way of working out. He joins Marion, Johnathan, Ken and Jerry when Sora's friends form Freedom Lights after Yuri takes over Kaleido Stage. Jean showed Marion her mother's performance journal, which helped inspire her to perform on the Children's Stage. He is a good friend of Kalos. He also had a wife named Cynthia, who was not only Marion's mother, but a trampoline star on Kaleido Stage. She died, before the series began, because of a stage incident and it left Marion very hurt inside. But being with Sora helped Marion recover, something that made Jean happy to see.  (Source: Kaleido Star Wikia)

name: Kevin Hamilton
about: Mr. Hamilton is the father of Layla Hamilton and one of the people who invested in Kaleido Stage. Despite seeing how much his daughter loves performing on stage, he has high hopes of seeing Layla as an actress someday and hopes she'll give up on stage performing. After the death of Layla's mother, he buried himself in work to forget about it. Despite this, Layla worked especially hard at Kaleido Stage in hopes that she could make her father happy again, but to no avail. Thanks to Sora's efforts, he delivered a message to Layla on her birthday, telling her how much he loved her. Unknown to him, after Yuri took over Kaleido Stage and kicked Sora and her friends out, Layla returned to help Sora disguised as the Masked Star (he had thought that Layla would be in London on her film set, in which she left to be with Sora). When her identity is revealed during Sora and Layla's performance at the competition, he is very upset with her and questioned why she would intentionally leave her filming and return. Layla explained that she wouldn't be satisfied until she could perform a "perfect" show, and she felt she could with Sora as her partner. After that, he tells Layla to at least return to London and finish filming and leaves without a word. It wasn't until Yuri invited him to see Sora and Layla performing the Legendary Great Maneuver that he tells Layla how magnificent a performer she is. He is strangely absent during the second season, New Wings, despite the fact that Layla returns.  (Source: Kaleido Star Wikia)

about: Gates Capa was first seen serving as a wing-mate for Rosamia Badam while testing out their Baund Doc prototypes at Side 2, with Gates piloting prototype unit one with Loren Nakamoto as the on-board operator. During this test mission, Rosamia runs off with Kamille Bidan into one of the colonies and Gates pursues them, and ends up fighting Kamille up close before having to bring Rosamia back. He is later seen escorting the further-enhanced Rosamia piloting her MRX-010 Psyco Gundam Mk-II with him in his own Baund-Doc. While Rosamia is searching for the Argama, Gates ends up trying to defend the Dogosse Giar from Reccoa Londe's squadron, but when Rosamia was finally killed, Gates suffered some type of mental lapse before the Dogosse-Gier is destroyed. His fate remains unknown.  (Source: Gundam Wikia)

Initially a Jegan pilot, she inherits Amuro's Re-GZ after the completion of the ν Gundam. Kayra's courage and cheerful personality are inspirational to the Londo Bell's soldiers, but her skills prove insufficient to battle Neo Zeon's Newtypes. She has a relationship with Astonaige Medoz and tells him that she loves him just before her final sortie, though Astonaige apparently didn't catch that.    (Source: Gundam Wikia)

Never a poster child for bravery or self-confidence, Cyberhawk was charged by Convoy with protecting the Cybertron's (Autobots') human friends, surprising fellow Cybertrons with his new-found courage and an intense desire to keep his friends from harm. Cyberhawk was given to Rad, Carlos and Alexa shortly after the Cybertrons arrived on Earth. Ratchet provided him for the kids in order to give them the ability to help the Cybertrons during their mission. Shisei is a kind girl who loves her cousin Saito, she will console him whenever Akane gives him a hard time, she has told Saito that if he ever became homeless she would join him on the streets.  Shisei does have a mischievous side as seen when she found out about Saito and Akane's marriage and demanded Hush money from Saito, but this was probably a joke.  She is Saito Houjou's cousin. With a doll-like appearance and a captivating, cool demeanor, she shares a close friendship with Saitou, having grown up with him as if they were siblings. While she acts very simple and affectionate, she also is insightful when Saitou relies on her.  As a part of Houjou bloodline, Shisei was born with high IQ inherited from her ancestors. about: Name: Ann Birthdate: Jan 1, Capricorn Devil fruit: Bijo Bijo no Mi (Viso Viso Fruit) Type: Paramecia   Ann is a young woman with very curly light green hair which is mostly partitioned into two sections and purple eyes (light brown in One Piece live attraction artwork) and had freckles on her face. She wears a frilly white top with green sleeves that exposes her midriff and has a necktie whose design is based on Tokyo Tower. She wears a large skirt with green and white stripes that has a large number of black frills lining the bottom and wears green tights as well as green heels. She wears two bows, both of which are orange on the right side and have yellow and green stripes on the left. One bow is on the top of her head, while the other is on the back of her skirt.  Ann is a kind but ditzy girl. She quickly made friends with the Straw Hat Pirates, and she also is thoughtful enough to have asked Luffy if he wanted to see Ace again. However, she often gets easily distracted and forgets what she is doing until others remind her, including when she is performing or asking for help  Ann has a bright, spunky personality and puts a lot of spirit into her announcing during the Pirates Expo. She is not shy about her bias, actively cheering for Luffy and his crew. She is also somewhat of a diva in personality, getting frustrated at her co-announcer Donald Moderate for cutting off her sentences and stealing his microphone to goad her ego.  Ann ate the Bijo Bijo no Mi, a Paramecia-class Devil Fruit that allows the user to create "phantoms," or illusory images, by touching pictures. She can create phantoms of objects, plants, and even people that can then interact with their environment.   One Piece: Phantom      One Piece: Marionette     One Piece: Stampede:
